jobs.title: Computer Coding Instructor (Code Sensei)
jobs.description:
**Job description**

**Position: Code Sensei**

**Who are we?**

Code Ninjas is the nation’s fastest\-growing kids coding franchise. In our centre, kids learn to code in a fun, non\-intimidating way – by playing and building video games they love. Kids have blast and can’t wait to come back. Parents are thrilled as their children gain confidence and new skills including coding, math, logic, and problem\-solving, as they progress from white to black belt. Our core promise is, Kids have fun, and parents see results.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for Coding Instructors (a 'Code Sensei' as we call them) to join our team of dynamic, energetic, forward thinking minds, working toward our common goal of providing a fun and safe learning environment for children. Our sensei’s are the lifeblood of our Code Ninjas studio and play an integral role in coaching and engaging our young ninjas in our dojos. Yes, you read that right. Here at Code Ninjas we don’t have teachers but ‘sensei’s'; our students are 'ninjas' and our parent\-free learning area is the ‘dojo’.

You will be responsible to instruct \& couch ‘ninja’s’ (Students) as they embark the journey of learning coding, logic and problem\-solving skills in a progressive yet fun.

Are you a University, GCSE or A\-Level student having an interest in computing/coding/programming languages? Code Sensei could be the role for you.

Do you enjoy teaching and building problem solving skills in young engineering minds? Have you mentored youth? Are you experienced in teaching children? This could be the role for you.

In return Code Ninjas Hampstead, Camden will give you a fun and inspiring environment that will enable you to develop and succeed by providing relevant trainings. It will give you a platform to build your carrier by providing Code Ninja led trainings in computer coding \& programming languages whilst you help shape the minds of our future brains.

**Responsibilities include:**

* **Training to be a Sensei** – Training is offered for free to Code Sensei. You will be self\-training on various Code Ninja programs and achieve respective credits ('belts' as we call them) and be up to date with the full curriculum (game based \& computer programming).
* **Instructing as a Sensei** – responsible to instruct, teach \& guide young ‘ninjas’ (students) through the curriculum and help them achieve their belts, milestones and succeed
* Creating a fun, positive and safe environment in which our ninja students can grow.
* Working with our ninja students to help, support and enhance their soft skills such as confidence \& communication.
* Build and run holiday camps from a selection of popular camps in Code Ninja Library \* Participation in Parent and Child tours and taster sessions for prospective families.
* Providing brief feedback to parents after each session on their child’s development in that session.
* Following all opening and closing duties daily.
* Ensuring all health \& safety measures are maintained in the Centre at all times.
* Reporting daily to the Centre Manager with respect to the day’s activities and productivity in the dojo.
* Ability to deliver Virtual Lessons when the need arises.

**Qualifications:**

* Must have a passion for coding and technology
* Must be knowledgeable about coding and technology; or able to quickly pick up basic concepts, knowledge of at least one of the programming languages would be good to have \- JavaScript, Python, C\#, Scratch; and of platforms such as Roblox, Minecraft, etc
* A background in ICT/computer science or similar would be good to have \* Interest in teaching and mentoring.\*
* A working history with children ages 5 and up (mentoring, coaching, tutoring etc.) would be good to have
* Qualification in SEN would be nice to have
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
* Works well with others; collaborates and must be fun to work with and likes working in fast\-paced environments where requirements can change frequently

Expected hours: 8 – 12 per week

* Casual dress
* Company events
* On\-site parking
* Referral programme

* GCSE or equivalent (preferred)

jobs.title: Protection & Control Field Engineer
jobs.description:
**Base Location:** Flexible Scotland \| We're proud to offer a Flexible First approach to work, and this role is no exception. We will, however, need your base 'home' location to be within travelling distance to our Inverness or Elgin sites as you will spend the majority of your time working in Substations and on Projects in Inverness\-shire.

**Salary:** £50,964 \- £85,880 \+ overtime \+ standby \+ car/car allowance and a range of other benefits to support your family, finances and wellbeing.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible working options available


**The role**



As a Protection Field Engineer at SSEN Transmission, you'll be instrumental in achieving Net Zero. This hands\-on role is key to expanding and updating our network, directly ensuring the exceptional reliability and resilience of our transmission system for all users.


**You will**


* Ensure the Transmission network operates to the highest reliability standards through technical management of connected protection and control systems.
* Help deliver the multi\-million\-pound capital delivery programme on our transmission network, including the commissioning of new protection assets.
* Support all aspects of field protection work, including commissioning, maintenance, outage management, contractor liaison and budget management.
* At times, you may be required to work away from your base location due to the diverse nature, and sometime remote locations, of our plant and equipment.
* Participate in a paid out of hours standby rota due to the 24/7/365 nature of operating a high voltage Transmission network.


**You have**


* A qualification in a relevant electrical engineering subject (a minimum of HNC level with a recognised apprenticeship or suitable relevant experience being desirable).
* Previous experience and technical knowledge of power systems protection, including installation and commissioning of high voltage plant and apparatus up to 400kV.
* Strong understanding of reading and interpreting protection single line, schematic and block diagrams.
* Experience of carrying out testing and fault\-finding on secondary wiring and auxiliary equipment, including the application of logic and settings files on Protection intelligent electronic devices.
* Existing Senior Authorised Person (SAP) or High Voltage Switching authorisations at Transmission voltages up to 400kV, are highly advantageous for this role or if working towards this.


**A full UK driving license is required as this role will require travelling to our various locations.**



Please note: Applications will also be considered from electrical engineers from other sectors with less specific protection experience, with a starting salary commensurate with experience levels. Training and development will be provided to ensure continuous progress.

  



**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport energy from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown energy for the future and building a network for net zero to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. please contact Andy on andrew.torrance@sse.com / 01738 275370 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

jobs.title: Graduate Control Systems Engineer (SCADA / PLC / RTU)
jobs.description:
**About DCL**

Donavalli Consulting Limited (DCL) is a specialist Operational Technology (OT) and SCADA engineering consultancy based in Reading. We design, upgrade and support the control and telemetry systems that keep water and wastewater services running for millions of people across the South East, working primarily with Water Industry.

Our directly employed team of engineers works on live water industry projects: RTU migration programmes, SCADA platform upgrades, HMI improvements and OT cyber security. We operate management systems aligned to ISO 9001 (Quality), ISO 45001 (Health and Safety) and ISO 27001 (Information Security).

Being a small, specialist team means our graduates work alongside Principal and Lead engineers from day one, on real projects, with real responsibility.

**The role**

We are looking for a motivated engineering or computing graduate to join DCL as a Graduate Control Systems Engineer. You will learn to configure, test and commission SCADA, PLC and RTU systems used on water treatment works, sewage treatment works and remote pumping stations.

This is a structured development role. You will start with desk\-based configuration and testing under supervision, then progress to site surveys, commissioning and client\-facing work as your competence grows. The aim is to develop you towards a System Engineer role and, in time, professional registration with a recognised engineering institution.

**Key responsibilities**

* Configure and test SCADA databases, mimics and alarms on platforms such as AVEVA System Platform, InTouch and GeoSCADA (ClearSCADA).
* Support RTU configuration and migration work, including remote outstations and industry\-standard telemetry and communication protocols such as DNP3, WITS DNP3, Modbus, and OPC.
* Assist with PLC and RTU logic changes, including reading and modifying IEC 61131\-3 code (e.g. ISaGRAF, function block diagram, structured text).
* Carry out I/O and signal checks, point\-to\-point testing and data validation against survey and design records.
* Support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) and commissioning on operational water and wastewater sites.
* Produce and maintain engineering documentation: test sheets, I/O schedules, functional design inputs, as\-built records and change requests.
* Help develop and use DCL's in\-house Python and C\# tools that automate SCADA validation and data checking.
* Follow OT cyber security practice (IEC 62443 principles) and DCL's ISO 9001, 45001 and 27001 procedures, including safe systems of work on site.
* Work with Water operations and project teams, building good working relationships with clients and site staff.

**What we are looking for**

**Essential**

* A degree in Electrical, Electronic, Control, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Physics or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience such as a completed engineering apprenticeship.
* Basic programming or scripting experience (e.g. Python, C\#, C, or PLC programming from coursework or projects).
* Good understanding of IT fundamentals: Windows, networking (IP addressing, subnets) and Microsoft Office.
* Clear written English, able to produce accurate technical records.
* A methodical approach to testing, with strong attention to detail.
* Willingness to travel to operational sites and work outdoors in all weathers when required.
* The right to work in the UK. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

**Desirable**

* A full UK driving licence (or working towards one).
* Exposure to PLC, SCADA or HMI systems through placement, final\-year project or hobby work (e.g. Allen\-Bradley, Schneider).
* Awareness of industrial communication protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP).
* Interest in OT cyber security or the water industry.
* A CSCS card or other site safety training.

**Training, development and benefits**

* DCL Engineer Development Pathway, with gateway assessments.
* Mentoring from Principal and Lead engineers on live projects.
* Practical training in our Reading test environment, using DCL's own Engineering Suite tools.
* Vendor training on AVEVA, GeoSCADA and Schneider Electric platforms.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**At Mako, we believe in the power of collaboration to drive innovation in pursuit of our collective ambition; excellence in trading. Our diverse community is connected through a commitment to being the best we can be with the highest standards of integrity.**



We're looking for a Platform Engineer to help design, build, and operate our on\-premises Kubernetes platform running on a self\-managed Linux VM fabric (KVM/libvirt\-based hypervisor layer). You'll own the infrastructure that sits beneath our application workloads — from the hypervisor and VM provisioning up through Kubernetes cluster lifecycle, networking, storage, and the golden\-path tooling that application teams use to ship software.



This is a hands\-on, deeply technical role for someone who enjoys operating infrastructure at the systems level — not a cloud\-managed\-service consumer role. The VM fabric itself is still being designed and built out, so you'll have real influence over its architecture, not just its day\-to\-day operation. You'll be responsible for keeping the fabric and the clusters running on top of it healthy, secure, and performant, without the safety net of a hyperscaler's managed control plane.


**What you'll be involved in:**


* Design the Linux VM fabric underpinning the platform from the ground up: hypervisor architecture (KVM/libvirt), host networking topology, storage backing for VM disks, and how the fabric will scale as workload demand grows
* Operate and maintain the hypervisor layer across multiple physical hosts, including host patching, live migration/evacuation, and failure response with minimal workload disruption
* Design and maintain a distributed shared storage system such as Ceph, or an alternative
* Design and maintain VM templating and golden\-image pipelines so Kubernetes nodes are provisioned consistently and can be rebuilt or rotated on demand
* Automate the VM lifecycle end\-to\-end — provisioning, scaling, patching, decommissioning — via infrastructure\-as\-code
* Manage compute, memory, and storage capacity planning across the fabric, including host\-level oversubscription strategy and headroom for node failure or maintenance
* Own virtual networking within the fabric — host networking, VLANs/overlay networks — and design how it hands off cleanly into the Kubernetes CNI layer above it
* Design, build, and maintain the full lifecycle of on\-prem Kubernetes clusters: bootstrapping, version upgrades, node scaling, and decommissioning, using tooling such as kubeadm, Cluster API, or Kubespray
* Manage the control plane end\-to\-end, including etcd operations (backup/restore, performance tuning, disaster recovery), since there's no managed control plane to fall back on
* Configure and tune cluster networking: CNI selection, network policy enforcement, and on\-prem load balancing
* Stand up and manage ingress and internal DNS for workloads across environments
* Own persistent storage integration for stateful workloads via CSI drivers
* Define and enforce multi\-tenancy patterns across both layers — tenant isolation and resource allocation on the VM fabric (compute, storage, network) as well as namespace/resource quota strategy, RBAC, and policy enforcement (OPA/Gatekeeper or Kyverno) at the Kubernetes layer
* Build and maintain GitOps\-based delivery for both cluster configuration and workloads (ArgoCD or Flux), treating cluster and infrastructure state as code
* Harden hosts and clusters against security baselines (CIS benchmarks for Linux and Kubernetes), manage secrets (Vault, sealed\-secrets), and keep the container runtime and node OS patched
* Build observability across the full stack — from hypervisor/host health up through cluster metrics and logs (we currently use Prometheus, Grafana, OpenSearch, and Checkmk; open to alternatives) — with particular focus on the capacity and failure signals a managed cloud provider would normally surface for you
* Plan and execute Kubernetes version upgrades and node OS/kernel upgrades with minimal workload disruption
* Design and maintain disaster recovery and backup strategy spanning both layers — VM snapshots/backups and etcd/cluster state — so the platform can be rebuilt from bare infrastructure if required
* Troubleshoot incidents across the entire stack — from a misbehaving pod, down through kubelet, container runtime, and CNI, into the underlying VM and hypervisor layer when needed
* Participate in an on\-call rotation for platform\-level incidents; drive root\-cause analysis and post\-incident reviews
* Partner with application teams to define and support a smooth developer experience (self\-service namespaces, CI/CD integration, internal developer platform tooling)
* Coordinate with datacentre/facilities and network teams on physical host provisioning, rack capacity, and hardware refresh cycles
* Contribute to the platform roadmap: capacity growth, tooling upgrades, and reducing operational toil through automation

  


**What we need from you:**


**Essential**


* Solid production experience running Kubernetes in a self\-managed, on\-premises context (not just EKS/GKE/AKS) — you understand what breaks when there's no managed control plane, and you've operated etcd and the control plane yourself
* Hands\-on experience designing and operating a Linux KVM/libvirt\-based VM fabric as the foundation for Kubernetes — host architecture, templating, and provisioning automation, ideally from relatively early stage rather than just inheriting a mature environment
* Strong Linux systems administration background (networking, storage, service management, kernel tuning, troubleshooting under pressure)
* Practical, in\-depth knowledge of Kubernetes networking (CNI internals, service meshes a plus) and storage (CSI drivers, distributed storage systems such as Ceph/Longhorn)
* Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and configuration management (Terraform, Ansible, Packer)
* Experience with GitOps workflows and CI/CD pipelines
* Comfortable with observability stacks (Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/Loki) and using them to diagnose infra issues without cloud\-native tooling
* Security\-conscious: familiar with hardening standards, RBAC, network segmentation, and secrets management
* Strong troubleshooting instincts across the full stack — hypervisor, OS, network, container runtime, Kubernetes control plane
* Good written and verbal communication; comfortable working with distributed/hybrid teams


**Desirable**


* Experience with bare\-metal Kubernetes provisioning
* Background in a regulated or air\-gapped/restricted\-network environment
* Contributions to open\-source infrastructure tooling
* Experience using AI tooling (e.g. AI coding assistants, LLM\-based automation) to accelerate development — we're keen to use AI to speed up our development cycle
* Experience running AI infrastructure.

  


**Why This Role**



You'll have real ownership over infrastructure end\-to\-end — from the hypervisor to the pod — with no black\-box managed services standing between you and root cause. If you like understanding systems all the way down and want to shape how a platform team operates outside the public cloud, this is that role.



We're a FOSS\-first company for our on\-prem infrastructure: we build our platform on open\-source tooling where it fits, rather than defaulting to proprietary or vendor\-locked products. That means fewer licensing constraints on how you design solutions and direct access to the source when something needs to be understood or fixed at depth.

  


**We are Mako**



At Mako, we are welcoming, inclusive and collaborative. We work fast and smart in a supportive and dress\-down environment that allows colleagues to be themselves and achieve great things. We uphold the principles of a flat structure that offers unrivalled engagement with senior leadership and career development opportunities. We have a comprehensive benefits package, including:


* Flexible leave and hybrid working policies
* Private health and dental insurance
* Generous pension scheme
* Free access to the Mako gym
* Employee wellbeing guidance and support
* Opportunity to become involved in the rewarding work of the Mako Foundation

  


**About Mako**

Mako is a leading options market maker with a global trading footprint. It has been at the forefront of options market making since 1999, from the open outcry trading pits to screen trading and automated algorithmic execution strategies that are driving the future of the industry.



From offices in London, Dublin, Amsterdam, Singapore, Sydney, Brisbane and Chengdu, Mako offers the best\-in\-class liquidity solutions across Equities, Fixed Income, Commodities and FX derivatives markets and prides itself in its entrepreneurial, collaborative and philanthropic culture.

  



If you require any reasonable adjustments or assistance during the recruitment process, please email hr@mako.com and we will arrange this.

  



For further information on the Mako Group please refer to our website: www.mako.com.

  


*Mako does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate details from recruiters or search firms and will not pay any fees to such firms without a signed agreement.*

jobs.title: Software Standards Manager
jobs.description:
Alliance Automotive Group (AAG) is a leading distributor of passenger and commercial vehicle parts to the independent automotive aftermarket in Europe. It operates in France, the U.K., Ireland, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, Portugal, Poland, Hungary and Romania. The company is a wholly\-owned subsidiary of Genuine Parts Company (GPC), the largest global automotive replacement parts distributor with activities in North America, Europe, and Australasia. AAG’s network serves thousands of customers across Europe supported by a logistics infrastructure of 75 Distribution Centres, approximately 2,550 Stores and thousands of vehicle repairers, body shops and auto\-centres. AAG has a revenue of 3\.4 billion euros with over 17,000 employees. Learn more at www.allianceautomotivegroup.eu

  

The Software Standards Manager is a new role within Alliance Automotive UK \& Ireland, reporting to the Head of Digital \& Internal Applications. Operating across both B2B, B2C and internal technology teams, this role exists to bring structure, visibility, and control to a diverse and evolving software landscape shaped by organic and acquisition growth.

  

With multiple homegrown and proprietary applications primarily built on .NET and LAMP stacks, our engineering teams have historically operated with autonomy in tooling, frameworks, and processes. As we continue to scale, we must now centralise standards around source code management, vulnerability remediation, technical debt allocation, and risk reporting—without disrupting the pace of business value delivery.

  

The Software Standards Manager acts as the bridge between delivery\-focused development teams and compliance, cyber, and risk stakeholders. This role protects engineering capacity by creating a structured intake and prioritisation model for security and compliance requests, ensuring they are logged, translated into backlog items, and progressed in a measurable way.

  

You will own the catalogue of internally developed applications, maintain visibility of framework lifecycle status, and oversee vulnerability posture across SAST and monitoring tools such as New Relic and Tenable. Through clear weekly reporting and monthly scorecards, you will provide leadership with a single, reliable view of remediation progress and risk exposure.

  

This is a highly visible and influential role, combining governance, technical literacy and stakeholder management to ensure our software estate is secure and sustainable.

 **Responsibilities**

 **Technical Role Delivery**

  

* Own and maintain a centralised catalogue of all internally developed applications, including framework versions, hosting environments, ownership, and lifecycle status
* Drive the centralisation and standardisation of code repository management and software governance practices
* Establish and manage a structured intake process for cyber and compliance requirements
* Consolidate vulnerability findings from tools such as New Relic, Tenable, and other monitoring platforms
* Translate security and compliance findings into clearly defined, prioritised backlog items within Agile workflows
* Participate in Agile ceremonies (stands\-ups, reviews, retrospectives) to ensure visibility and progress of remediation tasks
* Advocate for and track a defined allocation of development capacity toward technical debt and vulnerability remediation
* Protect development teams from unstructured or reactive requests by creating a controlled and prioritised engagement model

 **Performance \& Reporting**

  

* Act as the primary liaison between Digital, Compliance, and Cyber teams
* Design and own structured reporting templates, dashboards, and scorecards
* Provide weekly progress updates and monthly governance scorecards to the Head of Department(s) and wider stakeholders
* Establish a single source of truth for software risk posture and remediation progress
* Clearly communicate risk exposure, remediation velocity, and technical debt reduction trends
* Reduce reactive reporting cycles by implementing consistent and predictable governance communications
* Support leadership decision\-making with accurate, transparent, and actionable insights
* Deliver a long\-term change program to enable Ping Identity IGA \& MFA across all employee\-accessed applications

 **Candidate Qualities \& Experience**

 **Essential Requirements**

  

* Proven experience working within software engineering environments (Agile/DevOps)
* Strong understanding of SDLC, backlog management, and sprint planning processes
* Practical experience with vulnerability management and SAST tooling
* Ability to interpret technical risk and translate it into prioritised, actionable remediation plans
* Demonstrated ability to influence engineering teams without direct line management authority
* Experience designing and delivering structured reporting to senior stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of modern application stacks (including .NET and/or LAMP environments)
* Familiarity with cloud hosting environments and application lifecycle management
* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or related discipline

 **Highly Desirable Qualities**

  

* Experience centralising code repositories and driving engineering standards across multiple teams
* Exposure to multi\-entity or acquisition\-led environments with fragmented technology estates
* Experience engaging with Cyber Security and Compliance stakeholders
* Experience building governance dashboards or automated reporting metrics
* Exposure to SSO and IGA rollout projects (preferably Ping Identity)
* Relevant professional certifications, such as:
	+ Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
	+ Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
	+ Agile/Scrum certifications
	+ ITIL (Service Management)

 **Personal Attributes**

  

* Structured and disciplined thinker who brings order to complex environments
* Pragmatic and commercially aware, balancing risk reduction with business value delivery
* Calm and credible under pressure, able to manage competing stakeholder demand
* Confident communicator who can translate technical detail into executive\-level clarity
* Resilient and assertive when protecting engineering capacity
* Naturally collaborative, building trust across Development, Cyber, Compliance, and Leadership teams
* Outcome\-focused, with a bias toward measurable progress and continuous improvement

  

Not the right fit? Create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!  

  

Alliance Automotive Group is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.title: Staff InfoSec Engineer
jobs.description:
Krakow, Poland Category Engineering, Product, \& UX Design
  
Job description
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high\-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close\-knit, high\-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.
  

  

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
**Staff InfoSec Engineer**
**Why We Have This Role**


Qualtrics is looking for a Senior Lead of CDU Operations to lead the (Kraków) team’s daily operations that are responsible for detecting, triaging, and responding to security threats across our global environment. You'll own the day\-to\-day operations of your team, build and mentor a high\-performing team of analysts, and continuously mature our detection and response capabilities to keep pace with an evolving threat landscape. This is a hands\-on leadership role — you'll support in guiding strategy while staying close enough to work alongside the team and manage incidents.
**How You’ll Find Success**


* Strategic Visionary: You possess an in\-depth understanding of the cybersecurity threat landscape and proactively identify emerging risks. You help shape the Security Operations strategy, ensuring alignment with the organization's overall goals.
* Technical Innovator: You drive continuous improvement by evaluating and implementing cutting\-edge security tools, techniques, and automation. Your relentless pursuit of innovation keeps us ahead of evolving threats.
* Collaborative Leader: You build strong cross\-functional partnerships, championing security across the organization. You foster a collaborative environment where teams work seamlessly to achieve a strong security posture.
* Resilient and Adaptive: You thrive in a dynamic environment, effectively managing complex security projects and leading teams through change. Your ability to adapt and problem\-solve makes you a key asset during challenging situations.

**How You’ll Grow**


* Shape Industry Standards: Participate in leading security conferences, thought leadership initiatives, and industry working groups to shape the future of cybersecurity practices.
* Executive Presence: Gain direct exposure to executive\-level decision\-making, refining your strategic communication and influencing skills.
* Expand Your Leadership Toolkit: Lead a team of skilled security professionals, providing you with ample opportunities to enhance your mentorship, coaching, and talent development abilities.
* Complex Problem\-Solving: Tackle high\-impact security challenges that will push your critical thinking, analysis, and strategy\-building skills.

**Things You’ll Do**


* Lead and manage the Security Operations Center, including 24x7 monitoring, detection, triage, and incident response functions
* Hire, coach, and develop a team of CDU analysts and incident responders; build career paths and a strong on\-call/rotation culture
* Senior Lead needs hands\-on credibility. Conduct 1\-on\-1 technical coaching, run mock incident drills, and build skill matrices for junior analysts.
* Own CDU metrics and KPIs (MTTD, MTTR, alert volume/fidelity, coverage) and report on program health to security leadership
* Drive continuous improvement of detection logic, playbooks, and automation in partnership with detection engineering and threat intelligence teams
* Serve as an escalation point and incident commander for high\-severity security incidents, coordinating cross\-functional response
* Partner with Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, IT, Legal, and Product/Engineering teams to close gaps in visibility and response
* Manage relationships with any outsourced/MSSP or co\-managed CDU partners, ensuring SLAs and quality standards are met
* Evaluate and help select CDU tooling (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, XDR, ticketing) and drive adoption of automation to reduce analyst toil
* Own CDU\-related audit, compliance, and customer trust requirements (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP as applicable)
* Build and maintain incident response runbooks, tabletop exercises, and post\-incident review processes
* Participate in an on\-call rotation for incidents and provide leadership presence during major security events

**What We’re Looking For On Your Resume**


* Required:
	+ 7\+ years in security operations, incident response, or a related security discipline, including 4\+ years in a people\-management or team\-lead role
	+ Demonstrated experience running or scaling a 24x7 CDU function, whether in\-house, hybrid, or via MSSP oversight
	+ Strong technical grounding in SIEM/SOAR platforms, EDR/XDR, network and cloud security monitoring, and the MITRE ATT\&CK framework
	+ Experience leading incident response for significant security events, including coordination with legal, communications, and executive stakeholders
	+ Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining security talent
	+ Excellent communication skills — able to translate technical detail into risk\-based language for non\-technical leaders
	+ Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and SaaS security operations
* Nice to Have:
	+ Experience in a SaaS or enterprise software company handling customer data at scale
	+ Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to Qualtrics' customer base (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, GDPR)
	+ Relevant certifications (CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, CISM, or similar)
	+ Experience building or maturing threat detection and threat hunting programs
	+ Background in scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell) to support SOAR workflows

**What You Should Know About This Team**


* Innovation at Our Core: Our Security Operations team embraces change and thrives on solving complex challenges. We value experimentation, continuous learning, and push the boundaries of conventional security practices.
* Collaborative Environment: We believe in the power of teamwork and foster open communication across the team and the wider organization. Your ideas will be heard, and your collaboration will be essential.
* Data\-Driven Approach: We rely on data\-driven insights to inform our security strategies, measure effectiveness, and continuously improve our posture.
* Growth Mindset: We are committed to your professional development. You'll have opportunities to expand your expertise, contribute to high\-visibility projects, and advance your career in cybersecurity.
* Joining our team means stepping into a role that's vital, challenging, and deeply linked to Qualtrics' aim of reshaping industries by harnessing the power of Experience Management and AI.
**Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits**


* Annual Leave: 20 or 26 annual leave days per annum plus an additional day for each year of service (to a max of 5\).
* Private Medical Insurance\- Luxmed health \& dental cover for you and your dependants.
* Commuter Assistance\- Up to the value of 80 PLN net a month for public transport.
* Savings Plan\- Two company saving plans provided by Nationale Nederlanden: Employee Capital Plan (PPK) \& Employee Saving Plan (PPO),
* QED PROGRAM\- Qualtrics Engineer Development (QED) program: support, engineering learning activities up to 10% of engineering work time each quarter.
* Wellness\- Up to the value of 800PLN gross per quarter can be reimbursed for a variety of wellness activities via our dedicated platform Forma,
* A choice of Multispot cards available.
* Our employee assistance program with Unum provides counselling and wellbeing support to all employees
* Experience bonus\- 7000 PLN gross per annum. Qualtrics experience bonus is a program designed to provide experiences to our employees they might not otherwise have.
* Group Life \& Income Protection Insurance
* Glasses/Contact lenses Reimbursement
* Free breakfasts, lunches, snacks, and drinks for everyone in the office
* Tax\-deductible expenses (up to 50% depending on role)

**The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model**: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in\-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. \#hybrid
*Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.*
*Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:**Family \& Medical Leave Act**,* *Equal Opportunity Employment**,* *Employee Polygraph Protection Act*
*Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.*

Sign up for exclusive access to content created with you in mind and get the scoop on what we have going on at Qualtrics \- upcoming events, behind the scenes stories from the team, interview tips, hot jobs, and more. No spam \- we promise! You'll hear from us two times a month max with fresh, totally tailored info \- so be sure to stay connected as you explore your best role and company fit.*

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Developer (Azure/MS Data Fabric/Collibra)
jobs.description:
##### **Project description**


Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.
  

  

Your Skills And Experiences
  

  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C\#, PowerShell, Python
* Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade\-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
* Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
* Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
* Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
* Proactive thinking, excellent problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
* Fluent in English

  

Preferred Skills
  

  

* Strong coding skills (e.g. C\#, PowerShell)
* Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
* Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
* Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
* Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.

##### **Responsibilities**


Support the integration between Collibra and Microsoft Fabric, including evaluating Fabric's capabilities for data provision.


Manage Fabric\-native catalog and discovery functionalities.


Oversee metadata management and business glossary maintenance.


Facilitate data product discovery and data shopping processes.


Handle governance, access management, and data protection policies.


Lead proof\-of\-concept initiatives and validate Fabric architecture.


Design components such as OneLake, data mesh, and semantic layers.


Develop cloud architectural strategies ensuring security, scalability, and compliance.


Serve as a trusted advisor to align technical solutions with strategic objectives and advocate customer interests among diverse stakeholders.


Design and implement governance automation leveraging modern technologies and cloud best practices.


Lead technical collaboration with business, development, and infrastructure teams.


Produce technical documentation, architecture decision records, and implement DevOps practices including infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployments.


Coordinate team resources, resolve technical issues, and work within Agile frameworks, including Scrum and Kanban, for defining, estimating, and delivering work.


##### **Skills**


Must have


Python,


Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS),


Microsoft Azure DevOps,


Microsoft Azure Services,


Microsoft Data Fabric,


Network,


IP Routing,


TCP/IP,


CI/CD


Nice to have


Proven experience of working with MS Data Fabric (DP\-600/DP\-700 certifications),


experience in building AI Landing zones,


experience with FabricIO \& o365 agents,


C\# proficiency, Databricks,


self\-driven/self\-motivated,


PowerShell.


##### **Other**


Languages


English: B2 Upper Intermediate


Seniority


Senior

jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated Software Developer Intern who wants to grow at the intersection of software engineering and cybersecurity. You will join an R\&D engineering environment and contribute to the development of enterprise software while working closely with our Application Security team and Security Champions.


This is not a traditional cybersecurity internship focused only on policies, reports, or vulnerability scanning. You will write software, understand real application architectures, and learn how to design, implement, test, and operate software securely.


The goal is to develop a software engineer with strong Application Security expertise who can progressively take on the role of a Security Champion within the development organization.

### **Role description \& Responsibilities**

* Assist team members with feature development and maintenance using .NET and C\#, working with APIs, REST, gRPC and modern service architectures.
* Write and maintain unit and integration tests to ensure robust, clean, and reliable code.
* Conduct technical research and spikes to help solve complex platform challenges.
* Actively participate in team agile ceremonies, code reviews, and daily operations, working with Git and CI/CD pipelines.
* Contribute to secure code reviews, threat modeling, and the definition of security requirements for new features.
* Support the analysis and triage of vulnerabilities using SAST, SCA, and DAST tooling.
* Get involved in security testing of APIs and services, as well as authentication, authorization, and cryptography topics.
* Explore how Artificial Intelligence can improve Application Security, e.g. AI\-assisted secure code review, vulnerability prioritization, and automation of repetitive AppSec activities.
### **Qualifications**

* Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related studies
* Basic programming experience, preferably C\# / .NET, Java, Python, C\+\+, or a similar language
* Understanding of object\-oriented programming, basic web technologies/APIs, and basic knowledge of databases and SQL.
* Familiarity with Git and a basic understanding of software engineering best practices and unit testing frameworks.
* Familiarity or strong interest in DELMIA Apriso or manufacturing operations software.
* Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, secure coding principles, authentication/authorization, or common vulnerabilities (e.g. injection, XSS, broken access control) is an advantage, but not required.
* Eagerness to learn, take initiative, and work collaboratively in a team environment.
* Good communication skills in English (written and spoken).

### 

### **What's in it for you**

* Great opportunity to gain hands\-on, practical experience at the intersection of software engineering, cybersecurity, and AI within the IT industry
* Supportive and knowledgeable team, ready to share expertise and best practices
* Wide variety of projects and tasks, ambitious goals and independence in achieving them
* Flexible working hours
* Chillout rooms
* Access to training platform (languages, soft/hard skills)
* Multinational work environment
* And last but not least: Healthy Breakfast once a month, Fruity Tuesdays, Sweets on Thursdays, public transport compensation and MultiLife platform access

-----------------------

jobs.title: Senior .NET Engineer with AI
jobs.description:
We are seeking a skilled **Senior .NET Engineer** with experience in Cloud and AI technologies to join a dynamic development team on a project for one of our key Clients. In this role, you will design, develop and maintain robust, scalable, and secure web applications and services using .NET, cloud and AI technologies. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver cutting\-edge solutions that drive business goals and enhance user experience.


This position requires a hybrid model, with 3 days per week working from the office in Wroclaw.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain web\-based applications, services, and APIs using .NET technologies (C\#, ASP.NET Core, etc.)
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers to define application requirements and architecture
* Deploy, integrate, and monitor software on cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform
* Implement cloud\-native principles, leveraging technologies like serverless computing, containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud storage solutions
* Integrate and leverage AI technologies in real\-world projects
* Evaluate, select, and implement AI models and frameworks beyond basic tool usage
* Identify opportunities to apply AI for process automation, analytics, or product enhancement
* Explain AI concepts and workflows to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Ensure applications are secure, high\-performing, and scalable by implementing best practices in security, performance optimization, and cloud architecture
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across production and non\-production environments
* Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, reusability, and maintainability
* Automate CI/CD pipelines to streamline deployment processes and enable continuous delivery of new features
* Stay updated on the latest trends in .NET frameworks, cloud and AI technologies, and relevant development tools
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the technical knowledge base of the team

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years of professional experience in software development using C\# and .NET technologies (ASP.NET, ASP.NET Core)
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform
* Strong understanding of cloud\-native architectures and tools like Docker, Kubernetes, or serverless frameworks
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience integrating and leveraging AI technologies in real\-world projects
* Ability to evaluate, select, and implement AI models and frameworks beyond basic tool usage
* Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts such as model training, data preprocessing, and prompt engineering
* Proven track record of identifying opportunities to apply AI for process automation, analytics, or product enhancement
* Familiarity with limitations and best practices in AI adoption and deployment
* Capacity to explain AI concepts and workflows to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Proficiency with relational and non\-relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or DynamoDB
* Hands\-on experience with RESTful API design and development
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions
* Solid understanding of software development best practices, such as Agile methodologies, unit testing, and version control (Git)
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills with strong attention to detail
* Effective communication and collaboration skills in a team\-oriented environment

**Nice to have**

* Experience with frontend technologies such as React or Angular

**We offer**

* We gather like\-minded people:
* + Top tech minds driving innovation in AI, cloud and digital platform modernization
	+ Supportive team and agile, startup\-like culture
	+ Hybrid by design mode and opportunity to work remotely within Poland
	+ Chance to work abroad for up to 60 days annually
	+ Business\-driven relocation opportunities
* We provide growth opportunities:
* + Career development programs
	+ Thought leadership, mentoring, soft skills and well\-being programs
	+ Certification (Anthropic, Gemini, GCP, Azure, AWS)
	+ English classes
* We cover it all:
* + Stable pay
	+ Participation in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan with a 15% discount
	+ Benefits package (health insurance, multisport, shopping vouchers)
	+ Referral bonuses up to $2,000
	+ Offices featuring entertainment and relaxation zones, table tennis and football, free snacks, coffee and more
	+ Corporate, social and well\-being events
* Please, note:
* + Benefits listed above are available to employees only
	+ We are open for working with Contractors. Terms of B2B cooperation agreements are agreed individually
	+ We will reach out to selected candidates exclusively

jobs.title: Systemutvecklare integration
jobs.description:
#### **Var med och bygg informationsflödena som får Umeå Energi att fungera**

##### **Av Umeåborna, för Umeåborna**


Energibranschen förändras snabbt. Nya digitala tjänster, ökade krav på informationsutbyte och en växande mängd data gör integration till en allt viktigare del av hur vi utvecklar verksamheten.


På Umeå Energi är integrationer mycket mer än teknik. De skapar förutsättningar för allt från kundmöten och fakturering till energileveranser, affärsutveckling och interna beslut.


Nu söker vi en systemutvecklare som vill vara med och utveckla integrationslösningar som kopplar samman människor, system och information.

#### **Din roll**


Som systemutvecklare inom integration arbetar du med att utveckla, vidareutveckla och förvalta integrationslösningar som är centrala för Umeå Energis verksamhet.


Du blir en del av ett team som arbetar nära både verksamheten och andra delar av IT för att omsätta behov och idéer till hållbara, säkra och effektiva lösningar.


Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta genom hela utvecklingskedjan – från analys och design till implementation, driftsättning och vidareutveckling. Du är med och påverkar både lösningar, arbetssätt och teknikval samtidigt som du bidrar till att modernisera våra integrationsplattformar och informationsflöden.

#### **Det här blir en stor del av din vardag**

* Utveckla och förvalta integrationslösningar och API:er
* Omsätta verksamhetsbehov till hållbara tekniska lösningar
* Arbeta med analys, design, implementation och förvaltning
* Delta i utvecklingen av framtidens integrations\- och informationsplattformar
* Säkerställa kvalitet, stabilitet och prestanda genom testning och felsökning
* Samarbeta nära produktägare, arkitekter, utvecklare och verksamhet
* Bidra till arkitektur\-, design\- och teknikdiskussioner
* Vara med och utveckla teamets arbetssätt, kodbas och tekniska plattformar

#### **Vem vi söker**


Vi söker dig som gillar att förstå hur saker hänger ihop.


Du är nyfiken på både teknik och verksamhet och motiveras av att bygga lösningar som gör verklig nytta. Du trivs i sammanhang där du behöver förstå flera system, se helheten och samtidigt lösa detaljerade tekniska problem.


Du är ansvarstagande, prestigelös och tycker om att samarbeta med andra. Samtidigt är du trygg i att ta egna initiativ och driva frågor framåt när det behövs. Vi tror att du utvecklas av förändring och är nyfiken på nya tekniker, arbetssätt och möjligheter.

#### **För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har**

* Ett par års erfarenhet av systemutveckling med fokus på integration, API:er eller systemintegration
* Förståelse för integrationsarkitektur, REST\-baserade tjänster och informationsutbyte mellan system
* Erfarenhet av utveckling och felsökning i moderna utvecklingsmiljöer
* Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt
* Kunskap om API\-design
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD\-pipelines och moderna testmetoder
* Förmåga att arbeta genom hela utvecklingskedjan från behov till förvaltning


Vi ser gärna att du har relevant utbildning inom exempelvis systemvetenskap, datavetenskap eller motsvarande erfarenhet.

#### **Det är extra intressant om du har erfarenhet av**

* Integrationsplattformar eller middleware\-lösningar
* MuleSoft, OpenText Exstream
* Java eller C\#
* Komplexa integrationsmiljöer med många system och beroenden

#### **Hos oss får du mer än ett jobb**


Hos oss får du arbeta med lösningar som är viktiga på riktigt. Du blir en del av ett kompetent team där kunskapsdelning, samarbete och utveckling står i fokus.


Du får möjlighet att påverka hur vi utvecklar våra integrationslösningar framåt, samtidigt som du arbetar i en verksamhet som spelar en viktig roll för Umeås framtid. Här finns goda möjligheter att utvecklas, ta ansvar och bidra i en miljö där teknik och verksamhet möts varje dag.

### **Ansök senast 29 oktober**


Vi intervjuar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum gått ut. Har du frågor? Hör av dig till rekryterande chef Petra Ahlgren, petra.ahlgren@umeaenergi.se eller 070\-3082672\.


Som samhällsviktig verksamhet är det viktigt för oss med en trygg arbetsmiljö för våra medarbetare samt att våra tillgångar och information är skyddade. Som ett led i vårt systematiska säkerhetsarbete genomför vi därför en bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidaten för den här tjänsten. Några av våra roller kräver säkerhetsprövning, om det är aktuellt för tjänsten du sökt så kommer du att få mer information kring det i ett senare skede.


Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Välkommen till oss!


Reklam? Nej tack. Vi har valt partner för rekryteringsannonsering.

jobs.title: Cloud Developer – Building high-performance DevEx tools in Go/Golang
jobs.description:
The world of cloud is changing. Fast. And we want you, who thrive on the bleeding edge and build cleanly in **Go**, to transform the Cloud space with us!


We’re growing our team with a low\-ego, collaborative, and backend\-focused Cloud Developer who sees **Golang** as their home turf and **Developer Experience (DevEx)** as their main product. You are the force multiplier for client engineering teams: the connective tissue that builds internal tooling, CLI tools, microservices, and paved roads that allow everyone else to ship faster, safer, and with true engineering discipline, especially in an AI\-accelerated dev world.


If you love the simplicity, concurrency, and raw speed of Go, and get a kick out of building tools that other developers actually enjoy using, this is your Playground.


At heart, this is a developer\-productivity role. On assignment, you are the one who elevates a client's entire engineering engine:

* **Go as the core language:** You'll build internal services, custom CLIs, operator tooling, and lightweight backends primarily written in Go. *Of course*, we realize that you probably enjoy other languages as well (could be Java, Python, Typescript, .NET etc.) and this role is not at all limited to Go, it just has to be a proven weapon of choise in your arsenal
* **The Cloud is your substrate:** You bridge code, infrastructure, and delivery pipelines (CI/CD, IaC) so that shipping code to AWS, Azure, or GCP feels effortless for the rest of the team
* **DevEx in the AI Era:** Client teams are shipping faster than ever with AI coding tools. Your job is to build the surrounding guardrails, testing harnesses, and Go\-based tooling that keep that speed safe, reliable, and clean


You’re less about churning out standard end\-user business logic, and more about eliminating friction, reducing toil, and building the high\-speed infrastructure that other devs rely on daily.

### **What this role is (and is not)**

**What this role is:**

* **Primary Go/Golang Development:** Designing and building fast, concurrent, and reliable internal services, CLI tools, libraries, and developer platforms
* **Smoothing the path to production:** Developing CI/CD, build pipelines, and paved roads that make shipping code fast, safe, and repeatable
* **Elevating team velocity:** Doing the architectural and connective work that acts as a force multiplier for whole engineering orgs
* **Bringing discipline to AI workflow:** Creating the harnesses, guardrails, and integrations that let teams leverage AI without introducing chaos

**What this role is not:**

* **Not a "vanilla" feature dev:** You won't be stuck in standard CRUD/backlog feature loops. Your product is the developer platform itself
* **Not a frontend or pure Data/ML role:** You consume and integrate AI services and cloud primitives
* You don't train ML models or build data pipelines as your core craft

### **Who are you?**


Your temperament matters as much as your code. You’re a curious, low\-ego builder who takes pride in system craftsmanship, writes clean and maintainable Go code, and communicates clearly.

**Skills \& Background:**

* **Go (Golang) is your primary language and home turf:** You know its concurrency patterns, standard library, and ecosystem inside out.
* **5\+ years** in software engineering / backend / cloud engineering, with a genuine passion for *building for builders*
* Comfort or depth in at least one secondary modern language (e.g., Python, C\#, Java, or TypeScript)
* **Cloud \& IaC experience:** Solid foundation in AWS, Azure, or GCP, combined with Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi or Terraform preferred)
* **Demonstrable engagement with AI tooling:** Whether it’s building CLI wrappers around LLMs, using AI coding assistants in your workflow, or integrating AI SDKs into Go apps
* **Fluency in Swedish and English** (as client engagements are primarily conducted in Swedish)


Bonus: Kubernetes experience (managed or self\-managed).


Note: no ss\-hats wanted or needed.

### **Let's Play!**


Applying to us is a breeze!

* Upload your resumé or use your Linkedin profile
* Answer the choice\-questions (no "please\-rewrite\-your\-resume" nonsense, promise)
* Feel free to include links to your portfolio, GitHub or similar if you have stuff you're proud of that you want to share with us

**Important notes:**

* Playground Group does *not*provide visa sponsorship or relocation support
* Applicants must already have a permanent *and* independent right to work in Sweden
* As part of the final stage of the recruitment process, a background check conducted by a third party will be carried out.

### **Welcome to Playground!**


At Playground, you work on real, complex assignments for well\-established and ambitious clients, not bench projects or short\-lived experiments. Our teams are trusted with production systems, platforms, and data that actually matter. Here growth comes from ownership, curiosity, and doing the work properly. You’re trusted to think, contribute, and keep getting better, one meaningful step at a time.


Playground brings together specialized domains under one umbrella, with a shared culture and way of working, and easy access to broad technical expertise when it helps move the work forward.


Buzz: Cloud Engineer, SW Developer, Fullstack Developer, Software Architect, Coder, Hacker, Utvecklare, AI, AWS, GCP, Azure, Cloud Consultant

jobs.title: AI Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
AI is already changing how work gets done at CatalystOne. We're looking for someone who can design, build and operate AI solutions that create real business value, removing manual work, improving processes and helping colleagues focus on higher\-value work.


The whole company is your remit, the work is already underway, and we're small enough that something you build can be used by colleagues within weeks. This is an opportunity to help shape an AI practice from the beginning and see your work create visible impact across the business.


At CatalystOne, we help organisations create better workplaces through HR technology. Across the Nordics, we combine technology, people expertise and business understanding to help customers improve how work gets done. We're now applying the same thinking internally as we continue to expand how AI supports our own organisation.

### **About the AI Hub**


The AI Hub is a new function within People \& Technology, created to help CatalystOne identify, prioritise and realise the value of AI across the business.


We don't see AI as purely a technology topic. Introducing AI changes how work is organised, what people need to learn, and where human judgement matters most. We want those conversations considered together, close to the people doing the work.


The purpose of the AI Hub is to bring together process improvement, organisational change and technology to help teams work better and deliver stronger outcomes. As our AI Operations Engineer, you'll play a key role in turning ideas into solutions that people use every day.

### **The role**


Your users are your colleagues.


You'll build the systems, automations and AI\-powered solutions that consultants, support teams, sales teams and back\-office functions rely on to do their work. You'll work directly with the people experiencing the problem, helping shape solutions that fit how work actually happens.


This is a small team with a short path from idea to implementation. Some opportunities can move from a conversation on Monday to a solution in production that same week. Others require deeper technical design, data modelling or integration work. You'll help make those calls and take ownership of what gets built long after launch.


You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager to assess opportunities and agree scope. The AI Business Partner leads process improvement, adoption and value measurement. You lead technical design, engineering and operations. Both of you are involved while the problem is being defined and stay close after launch to ensure solutions create lasting value.


Some examples of what is already live


This isn't a greenfield AI initiative. We already have solutions creating value across CatalystOne today, including:

* An AI support agent that resolves around a fifth of internal IT tickets before they reach the IT team.
* Data products that save consultants time and provide business insights we didn't previously have.
* Automated workflows that reduce manual administration and move information seamlessly between teams.

The AI Hub exists to build on that foundation, helping CatalystOne identify the next opportunities, improve how work gets done, and ensure new solutions deliver measurable business value.

### **What you'll do**


You'll typically be involved throughout the entire lifecycle of a solution, from the first conversation through to operation and continuous improvement.


Your work will include:

* Building AI agents, automations and integrations that remove manual work and improve how teams operate.
* Working directly with colleagues to understand problems and shape practical solutions.
* Designing data models, workflows and integrations that support reliable AI solutions.
* Deciding where automation makes sense, where AI adds value and where human judgement should remain part of the process.
* Owning the solutions you build, including reliability, monitoring, security and cost management.
* Improving solutions based on how people actually use them.
* Creating documentation and reusable patterns that allow others to understand, maintain and extend your work.
### **Our technology stack**


Today we use Claude Code and Anthropic models, our own MCP servers running on Azure Container Apps, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions and Logic Apps. We already have agentic workflows running in production.


The tools will change. If something better comes along and you can make the case for it, you'll have room to improve the setup. Whatever we run needs to be secure, understandable, maintainable and cost\-effective.

### **What we're looking for**


We're less interested in a specific career path than in your ability to build reliable solutions that people depend on.


You'll likely bring:

* Experience building integrations, backend services, automations or internal platforms.
* Strong technical foundations in areas such as Azure, Microsoft Graph, APIs, serverless technologies, Python or C\#.
* Experience delivering AI\-powered solutions that real users rely on.
* Good technical judgement and the ability to choose simple solutions when they solve the problem.
* An understanding of security, reliability and operational ownership.
* Awareness of the trade\-offs between capability, speed, complexity and cost.
* The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical colleagues.

You care about the work behind the request, not just the technology. You want to understand how people use what you've built, whether they trust it and how it can be improved over time.


You don't need HR or HCM experience. If this sounds broadly like you, we'd love to hear from you.

### **What success looks like**


Your first few weeks will be about understanding our infrastructure, the solutions already running and the colleagues who use them.


You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager on new opportunities, helping assess what is technically possible and where the best place to start might be.


We want you building early, while giving you enough time to understand the environment you're responsible for.


By day 90, we'd expect you to have taken ownership of parts of the existing platform, contributed to new solutions entering production, and built strong relationships with the colleagues using them.

### **Why join CatalystOne?**


This is an opportunity to help build an AI practice from the beginning and see your work used by colleagues across the company.


You'll have the chance to:

* Build solutions that create visible business impact.
* Work directly with the people using what you build.
* Shape how the AI Hub develops.
* Experiment with modern AI technologies while staying focused on real business outcomes.
* Take ownership from idea through production and continuous improvement.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build practical AI solutions, solve meaningful business problems and help shape the future of work at CatalystOne, we'd love to hear from you.

### **Benefits**


As well as your salary, you’ll receive:

* Generous time off: A solid vacation allowance so you can recharge and regroup.
* Financial and health security: A comprehensive pension and insurance package, including private healthcare.
* Your well being, your way: A wellness contribution to help you stay on top of your health.
* Tech tools for efficiency: Laptop, mobile phone with subscription, and a home internet allowance.
* Flexible work setup: A hybrid model that supports your work life balance, with at least three days a week in the office.
* And more: Local benefits vary slightly by office, and we are happy to walk you through the details.
*CatalystOne does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. CatalystOne will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to the specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to CatalystOne on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.*

*We would like to inform you that all candidates who receive a job offer will be subject to a background check.*

*Then you might be our new Product Engineer!*

You will join EG's Construction R\&D organisation, working on Jydacom, ERP platform used across the construction industry. You will report to Timo Valonen, Senior Manager, Construction R\&D management, and work closely with developers, AI agents, Product Owners, and Product Managers on a daily basis.


Most of the development team is in Mangaluru, India, while your Finnish colleagues and stakeholders are based in Jyväskylä. English is the primary working language across the team, but fluent Finnish spoken and written is required to work closely with local stakeholders. The role is based in our Jyväskylä office.

* Gather and translate customer requirements into technical solutions.
* Deliver the final software product full\-stack — from frontend to backend and beyond to production deployment and monitoring.
* Ensure the whole path of quality from unit testing to production monitoring.
* Implement features and initiatives according to the product roadmap.
* Take ownership of internal tooling development.
* Also contribute to DevOps practices alongside the engineering team, helping maintain strong operational capability.
* Work closely with an Indian development team, leveraging AI in the development process.
* Collaborate primarily with internal stakeholders across the organization.
* Turning complex business logic into simple, elegant technical solutions.

**What You Bring**  

We care more about what you can do than what your CV looks like. Here's what will set you up for success:

**Must\-have**

* Senior\-level background as a software developer, with \+5 years of experience.
* Experience with modern web development, REST API.
* A production delivery mindset — you build production\-ready solutions designed to last.
* Understanding of how to build sustainable software products that meet customer needs in time while maintaining high technical quality.
* Experience delivering solutions fulfilling non\-functional technical requirements like maintainability, performance, security, observability.
* Strong collaboration skills and willingness to work in an international environment.
* Fluent written and spoken English and Finnish.

**Nice\-to\-have**

* Demonstrated experience designing or maintaining systems with extensive third\-party integrations and complex data models.
* Hands\-on development experience with Angular, TypeScript, .NET, and C\#.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Azure, Power BI, and Fabric.

**What's in it for you?**

* **Real ownership** — Own the quality and consistency of what AI agents and developers deliver, with real influence over how our software is built.

**We look forward to hearing from you!**  

If you would like more information before you apply, please contact our Senior Manager, Construction R\&D management, Timo Valonen, at timva@eg.fi or \+358 40 5593685\. We evaluate applications on an ongoing basis and recruit when the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are handled confidentially.

Our industry\-specific software helps people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.

Du får en central teknisk rolle i udviklingen af Roskilde Universitets Azure\-baserede integrationsplatform. Du skal udvikle integrationer og fælles komponenter samt bidrage til en robust og sammenhængende applikations\- og integrationsarkitektur. Samtidig får du mulighed for at fastlægge teamets standarder for kode, unittest og dokumentation inden for vores fælles arkitekturprincipper og i dialog med teamet. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med teamets øvrige udviklere, faglig koordinator og testmanager samt med arkitekter, drift og projektledere.


Roskilde Universitet er i gang med en omfattende digital modernisering. Vi udskifter og opgraderer centrale systemer og flytter løbende integrationer til en fælles integrationsplatform. Det stiller krav til robuste API’er, genanvendelige komponenter, sikker dataudveksling og løsninger, der kan overvåges, driftes og videreudvikles.


**Om Digital og dit team**  

Du bliver en del af Digitaliseringsenheden med 16 medarbejdere. Enheden hører under Digital, Roskilde Universitets centrale afdeling for IT, digitalisering, informationssikkerhed, samt projekt\- og procesmetoder. Digital har ca. 70 medarbejdere.


Din daglige base bliver udviklingsteamet, som består af fem udviklere, en fagkoordinator samt en testmanager. Teamet deltager i udviklingsprojekter og varetager samtidig den løbende vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling af universitetets systemer, integrationer og platforme.


**Arbejdsopgaver**  

Dine hovedopgaver i jobbet er at:


* Udvikle og vedligeholde integrationer, fælles komponenter og referenceimplementeringer på vores integrationsplatform.
* Omsætte behov, krav og arkitekturprincipper til tekniske designs og robuste løsninger samt videreudvikle principperne for udviklingsområdet i samarbejde med teamet og arkitekterne.
* Fastlægge og forankre teamets udviklingsprincipper og standarder samt løfte den tekniske kvalitet gennem code reviews, automatiseret test, dokumentation, faglig sparring og videndeling.

* Bidrage gennem hele DevOps\-forløbet fra analyse og udvikling til idriftsættelse, overvågning og fejlhåndtering.
* Anvende og videreudvikle teamets brug af AI\-baserede udviklingsværktøjer til kodning, test, dokumentation og fejlsøgning.

  

  

**Kvalifikationer**  

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for IT, softwareudvikling eller lignende. Du kan også have opbygget tilsvarende kompetencer gennem flere års relevant erhvervserfaring.


Vi forventer at du har:


* Solid erfaring med C\#, moderne .NET og objektorienteret softwareudvikling.
* Erfaring med design, udvikling og deployment af integrationer i Azure, gerne med Azure Functions og App Service.
* Erfaring med API’er, dataflows og datakontrakter samt databaser, SQL, JSON og XML.
* Erfaring med Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD\-pipelines og automatiserede unit\- og integrationstest.
* Evne til at omsætte krav og arkitekturprincipper til robuste løsninger, begrunde tekniske valg og dokumentere kode, snitflader og tekniske beslutninger.

* Identitets\- og adgangsstyring i Azure, herunder Entra ID, Managed Identities, Key Vault eller OAuth 2\.0\.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du arbejder struktureret, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og kan sætte dig ind i komplekse tekniske problemstillinger.
