**OUR STORY**

  

**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**

  

**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 122 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 49,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**

  

**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**

**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**

**Your role**

As an **Automation Software Engineer** , you will develop and **support software solutions** that enable automation, data acquisition, process control, and equipment integration in a high\-volume **semiconductor manufacturing** environment. You will work closely with equipment engineering, process engineering, production, quality, and DTIT teams to improve tool uptime (e.g. ALTS, SAM Machines, DAP/DAS, CPS etc), process stability, traceability, yield, and overall tool performance.


**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize automation and equipment control software for (DAP/DAS, ALTS, SAM Machines etc) semiconductor manufacturing systems.
* Support integration of production tools, test equipment, sensors, databases, MES, and factory host systems.
* Monitor, debug, and troubleshoot automation software, interfaces, and manufacturing applications to ensure stable operation.
* Analyze process and equipment data to identify abnormalities, improve performance, and support root\-cause analysis.
* Contribute to equipment qualification (User Acceptance Testing), software validation, and deployment of new automation solutions or upgrades.
* Document software logic, interface specifications, change records, and operating procedures.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on yield, cycle time, quality, reliability, cost, and safety.

**Your skills and experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Software Engineering, Electronics, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
* 1–3 years of experience in software development, automation, industrial control systems, or semiconductor manufacturing support.
* Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as **Python, C\#, C\+\+** , **Java** , or similar.
* Familiarity with semiconductor manufacturing systems such as **PLCs, MES, SECS/GEM** , databases, and equipment interfaces is a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues and perform root\-cause analysis **CAPA** .
* Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across engineering and production functions.
* Ability to work in a structured, fast\-paced cleanroom environment.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and eager to grow technically in a semiconductor manufacturing setting.
* Internship, project, or hands\-on experience in semiconductor automation or test software is an advantage.
* Build and maintain customized dashboards and reports to monitor system health, throughput, and utilization
* Extensive knowledge of Microsoft office suite

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2026 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics \& integrity, purpose \& values, organization \& change, business strategy, and performance.


At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (GenAI and Agentic Applications)
jobs.description:
**About Capgemini**

Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22\.5 billion.


**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an experienced, product\-minded Software Engineer to work directly with business units and use our established enterprise GenAI platform to deliver high\-impact AI and automation solutions.


In this forward\-deployed role, you will partner closely with business users to understand their workflows, translate often ambiguous needs into well\-scoped solutions, and own delivery from discovery and rapid prototyping through production rollout, adoption, and handover. You will build agentic workflows and custom applications using frameworks such as LangGraph and n8n, supported by strong backend, API, database, evaluation, and security engineering.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Business Discovery \& Solution Shaping:** Embed with business units to understand operational workflows, pain points, data, constraints, and intended outcomes. Facilitate discovery sessions, challenge assumptions, and translate needs into prioritised use cases, user stories, solution designs, and measurable success criteria.
* **Rapid Prototyping \& Iterative Delivery:** Build working prototypes quickly, validate them with users, and iterate based on evidence. Balance speed with maintainable engineering and take viable solutions through production deployment.
* **Agentic Workflow Engineering:** Design and implement reliable AI workflows and agents using Python\-based frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangGraph, LangChain, n8n, or equivalent technologies. Combine deterministic steps, LLM reasoning, tool calling, state management, human approvals, and exception handling as appropriate.
* **Custom Application Development:** Build fit\-for\-purpose applications around business use cases, including backend services, APIs, integrations, authentication, workflow logic, and lightweight user interfaces where needed.
* **Data \& Knowledge Integration:** Design robust data ingestion, transformation, and retrieval pipelines. Integrate enterprise systems, databases, document repositories, APIs, and search or vector services while maintaining data quality, lineage, and access controls.
* **Backend \& Database Engineering:** Develop secure, scalable backend services and APIs, and design relational data models using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL. Diagnose complex integration, performance, and state\-management issues.
* **AI Quality, Evaluation \& Observability:** Define evaluation datasets and acceptance criteria; test solution quality, reliability, latency, cost, and tool\-call success; implement tracing and monitoring; and continuously improve prompts, retrieval, workflows, and safeguards.
* **Security, Governance \& Responsible AI:** Apply secure engineering practices, least\-privilege access, data protection, prompt\-injection defences, output controls, auditability, and human oversight in line with government policies and the risk profile of each use case.
* **Deployment, Adoption \& Handover:** Own production readiness, testing, rollout, documentation, user enablement, support, and knowledge transfer. Track adoption and business outcomes and incorporate field learnings into reusable patterns and improvements to the core platform.
**Requirements**
----------------

* **Experience:** 5\+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated ownership of production applications from ambiguous requirements through deployment and support.
* **Backend Engineering:** Strong proficiency in Python or another modern backend language, API design, asynchronous processing, integration patterns, testing, debugging, and system architecture.
* **Database \& Data Engineering:** Strong experience with relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL, including data modelling and query optimisation; practical knowledge of data pipelines, search, and vector retrieval is also required.
* **GenAI \& Agentic Systems:** Hands\-on experience building LLM\-enabled applications, RAG solutions, tool\-calling agents, or automated workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, n8n, or equivalent.
* **Cloud \& Production Delivery:** Practical experience deploying and operating cloud\-native applications. Familiarity with AWS and services such as Bedrock and OpenSearch is preferred, although equivalent Azure or GCP experience is acceptable.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to work directly with non\-technical users, clarify business needs, explain trade\-offs, manage expectations, and drive adoption.
* **Delivery Mindset:** Comfortable working in ambiguous environments, learning unfamiliar business domains quickly, and balancing user value, delivery speed, security, reliability, and maintainability.
  

**Bonus Points:**

* **Forward Deployment:** Experience in consulting delivery, solutions engineering, internal product delivery, or another role involving direct collaboration with users and end\-to\-end implementation.
* **Workflow Automation:** Experience with visual workflow builders such as n8n or Flowise, including custom nodes, integrations, credential handling, and operational support.
* **Evaluation \& Observability:** Experience with LLM evaluation, tracing, observability, red\-teaming, or quality assurance tools and methods.
* **Regulated Environments:** Experience delivering applications subject to stringent data privacy, cybersecurity, accessibility, or government requirements, including IM8 policies.
**Let's talk about what's in it for you!**

  

Passionate people are Capgemini's Ace of Spades \- join us to discover a career that will challenge, support and inspire you. Working at Capgemini you'll find the rewards are more than just financial. You will work alongside some very smart and inspiring people on exciting projects and you will also enjoy incredible benefits. We offer flexible work practices and 40 hours of self\-development every year with a huge selection of learning opportunities to choose from.

  

As 'Architects of Positive Futures', Capgemini actively supports the community in 3 ways:

  

**Diversity and Inclusion** \- we believe diversity of thought fuels excellence and innovation, which is why we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of their gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, ability, intersex status or age. To support our commitment to diversity and inclusion, we celebrate special events and days of significance that are important to our employees such as Diwali, Bastille Day, Pride, IDAHOBIT, IWD and International day of people with Disabilities. Our Employee Resource Groups Women@Capgemini and OutFront support the grassroots passion of employees to drive our diversity agenda and effect change.

  

**Digital inclusion** \- at Capgemini we are using our skills to drive social impact initiatives focusing on helping society address the impact of the digital and automation revolution. We also provide employees with opportunities to give back to the community through charity projects and volunteer days.

  

**Environmental Sustainability** \- Capgemini joined the CDP's (Carbon Disclosure Project) prestigious 'A list' for its commitment to the Net\-Zero economy. We are focusing on helping our clients transform towards more sustainable business models and committing to reduce our own carbon emissions (GHG) by 20% per employee by2020 **.**

  

Recognized by Ethisphere as one of the **World's Most Ethical Companies** for the last 8 years in a row, ethics and values are at the heart of Capgemini's corporate culture and business. Embedded in our DNA, our seven values \- Honesty, Boldness, Trust, Team Spirit, Freedom, Fun and Modesty \- have remained the same since company inception in 1967\. To see how we bring these values to life, click here to listen to some of our employee’s stories.

  

Come join us, bring your whole self to work, create new possibilities for you, your customers and your community and help us to be Architects of Positive Futures.

* **Solution Architecture:** Experience reviewing system designs and data flows, assessing trust boundaries and integration risks, and recommending secure, proportionate architectures for cloud\-based applications.
* **Stakeholder Consulting:** Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain technical risks, challenge assumptions constructively, and guide internal stakeholders towards secure implementation decisions.

In this forward\-deployed role, you will engage users throughout the delivery lifecycle: observing existing workflows, identifying usability needs, translating findings into prototypes and interaction designs, and implementing production\-quality React interfaces for custom AI and workflow solutions.


You will bridge business users, product design, and engineering, making complex AI capabilities understandable, trustworthy, accessible, and easy to use. This role suits a product\-minded builder who is comfortable moving between user discovery, interaction design, coded prototypes, frontend engineering, testing, and production support.


**Responsibilities**

* **User Discovery \& Workflow Design:** Work directly with business users to understand goals, tasks, pain points, operating constraints, and current workflows. Translate findings into personas, journey maps, information architecture, user flows, and clear product requirements.
* **Prototyping \& User Validation:** Create wireframes, high\-fidelity designs, and interactive prototypes using tools such as Figma or coded prototypes. Facilitate usability testing, synthesise feedback, and iterate rapidly before and during implementation.
* **React Frontend Engineering:** Build responsive, maintainable, and production\-quality web applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Implement reusable components, robust state management, client\-side validation, error handling, and automated tests.
* **AI Interaction Design:** Design interfaces for conversational, generative, and agentic experiences, including streaming responses, tool execution, progress and system status, citations, user confirmation, human review, error recovery, and clear handling of uncertainty.
* **Design Systems \& Accessibility:** Apply and extend reusable design patterns, component libraries, and design tokens. Ensure solutions are consistent, responsive, inclusive, and aligned with applicable accessibility standards.
* **Backend \& Platform Integration:** Collaborate closely with AI and backend engineers to shape API contracts and integrate frontend applications with authentication, databases, enterprise systems, and platform services. Build lightweight backend functionality when required.
* **Quality, Performance \& Security:** Optimise usability, responsiveness, rendering performance, and reliability; implement unit, integration, end\-to\-end, and accessibility testing; and apply secure frontend practices for sensitive data and regulated environments.
* **Deployment, Adoption \& Handover:** Own frontend delivery through production rollout, documentation, user onboarding, feedback collection, support, and knowledge transfer. Use qualitative and quantitative signals to improve user adoption and task completion.

* **Experience:** 5\+ years of experience in frontend engineering, UX engineering, interaction design with hands\-on development, or a comparable product\-facing role, with evidence of shipping applications used in production.
* **Frontend Engineering:** Advanced proficiency in React and modern JavaScript or TypeScript, with strong knowledge of component architecture, state management, responsive design, API integration, performance optimisation, and automated testing.
* **UI/UX Practice:** Strong foundation in user\-centered design, information architecture, interaction design, prototyping, usability testing, visual hierarchy, and accessible design. Proficiency with Figma or equivalent tools is required.
* **Design\-to\-Code Capability:** Demonstrated ability to translate user needs and design concepts into polished, maintainable, production\-ready interfaces without relying on a separate handoff for every detail.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Strong communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to work directly with non\-technical users, uncover underlying needs, explain design and technical trade\-offs, and incorporate feedback constructively.
* **Product \& Delivery Mindset:** Comfortable working with ambiguous requirements, rapidly prototyping, testing with users, and taking ownership from discovery through rollout and continuous improvement.
* **Technical Breadth:** Working knowledge of backend APIs, authentication, databases, cloud environments, version control, CI/CD, and secure software development sufficient to deliver integrated applications with engineering partners.
  

**Nice\-to\-Have (Bonus Points):**

* **Forward Deployment:** Experience in consulting delivery, design engineering, solutions engineering, internal product delivery, or another role involving direct collaboration with users and end\-to\-end implementation.
* **AI Product Experience:** Experience designing or building interfaces for chatbots, copilots, agentic workflows, data\-rich applications, or other AI\-enabled products.
* **Design Systems:** Experience creating or extending component libraries and design systems, including documentation, accessibility considerations, and visual regression testing.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **AWS Ecosystem Administration:** Provision, configure, and manage essential AWS services supporting our applications. This includes managed relational databases (RDS PostgreSQL), search/analytics (OpenSearch), AI services (Bedrock), and networking/load balancing (ELB).
* **Network Architecture, Security \& Connectivity:** Design, operate, and troubleshoot secure AWS network architectures for regulated, multi\-account environments. This includes VPC and subnet design, CIDR planning, Transit Gateway routing and route\-table segmentation, centralized ingress and egress, AWS Network Firewall and WAF, security groups and network ACLs, private connectivity through VPC endpoints or AWS PrivateLink, DNS resolution, load balancing, and connectivity to shared services or on\-premises networks through VPN or Direct Connect. Apply network segmentation and least\-privilege principles across production, non\-production, management, and shared\-service environments.
* **Production Reliability, Observability \& Resilience:** Establish service\-level indicators and objectives, dashboards, alerts, logs, metrics, and distributed traces across infrastructure, Kubernetes, applications, and AI workloads. * **Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD \& Automation:** Use Terraform as the primary Infrastructure as Code tool to provision and manage repeatable AWS and Kubernetes environments. Administer and optimise GitLab CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, SAST, DAST, dependency and container scanning, policy checks, approval controls, immutable artefacts, environment promotion, rollback mechanisms, and auditable release records.

Work with cybersecurity, governance, product, and project stakeholders to translate government security requirements and enterprise standards into automated, testable controls.
* **Identity, Secrets \& Software Supply Chain Security:** Implement least\-privilege IAM, workload identity, privileged\-access controls, secrets and certificate management, container image signing and scanning, software bills of materials, dependency governance, and policy enforcement across infrastructure and deployment pipelines. Protect sensitive configuration and credentials, and maintain traceability of changes and releases.
* **Vendor Transition:** Work closely alongside existing external vendors to map the current architecture, reverse\-engineer undocumented configurations, and safely transition infrastructure operations fully in\-house.

----------------

* **Experience:** Typically 2 to 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, Cloud Engineering, or a similar role. We welcome candidates with fewer years of experience who can demonstrate strong practical capability, sound engineering fundamentals, and ownership of production systems. Strong experience with AWS EKS and Kubernetes networking is required, including ingress controllers, load balancers, service discovery, network policies, pod and service CIDR planning, and diagnosis of cross\-VPC or restricted\-egress connectivity issues.
* **AWS Networking:** Strong knowledge of complex AWS networking in multi\-account and regulated environments. Candidates should be able to design and troubleshoot VPCs, subnets, route tables, Transit Gateway attachments and segmentation, overlapping or constrained CIDR ranges, centralized firewalls and egress, VPC endpoints and PrivateLink, Route 53 private DNS, security groups, network ACLs, VPN or Direct Connect connectivity, and traffic flows across application, shared\-service, security, and on\-premises network zones.
* **CI/CD Tools:** Solid experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred).
* **Operational Readiness:** Proven experience defining service\-level objectives, building actionable monitoring and alerting, responding to production incidents, conducting root\-cause analysis, managing capacity, and designing and testing backup, restore, and disaster\-recovery arrangements.
* **Regulated Environments:** Experience delivering or operating systems under Singapore Government Commercial Cloud and IM8 requirements, or under comparably stringent regulatory frameworks in sectors such as banking, finance, healthcare, or critical infrastructure. jobs.title: Principal Consultant, Unified Engineering
jobs.description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**

**Job Title:** Technical Principal Consultant, AVEVA Unified Engineering

**Location:** Malaysia, Singapore

**Employment Type:** Full\-time, regular, hybrid work arrangement

**The job**

We are seeking a technically skilled engineer to join our team as a Technical Principal Consultant for AVEVA Unified Engineering (UE). This role focuses on the hands\-on implementation, configuration, and integration of UE within complex plant engineering environments. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in engineering data systems, software customization, and cross\-discipline integration.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead the technical implementation of AVEVA Unified Engineering solutions for EPCs and Owner Operators.
* Configure and customize UE modules to align with customer\-specific engineering workflows.
* Integrate UE with other AVEVA tools (e.g., ERM, AIM\-A, Worktasks etc) and third\-party systems via Application Program Interfaces (APIs).
* Develop scripts and extensions using PML, C\#, .NET, or other relevant technologies.
* Collaborate with customer teams to define data models, templates, and workflows.
* Create and maintain technical documentation including Requirement Definition Documents (RDDs), configuration guides, and training materials.
* Conduct technical workshops and training sessions for end users and administrators.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and post\-deployment support.
* Consult with global AVEVA development and support teams to resolve complex issues and contribute to product improvements.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 15\+ years of experience with AVEVA Unified Engineering or similar integrated engineering platforms
* Proficiency in engineering data modeling and multi\-discipline integration (process, piping, electrical, instrumentation)
* Hands\-on experience with AVEVA Engineering, P\&ID, E3D, or comparable tools
* Strong programming/scripting skills (e.g., PML, C\#, .NET, SQL, REST APIs)
* Familiarity with enterprise IT environments (Windows Server, databases, cloud platforms)
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Effective communication skills in English (written and verbal)
* Experience working in cross\-functional and international team.
* Willingness to travel for project delivery and customer engagement

**Services at AVEVA**


Our dynamic global team of 700\+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting\-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.


You’ll also be joining an award\-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition.


Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/

 **Singapore Benefits include:**


Parental leave, additional leaves including emergency leave, childcare leave and extended childcare leave, well\-being support, flexible benefits, group insurances, car Allowances (depending on the role), company’s gift.

  

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

 **Hybrid working**


We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on\-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office\-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

 **Hiring process**


Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring\-process

 **About AVEVA**


AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting\-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

  

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability\-report.aveva.com/

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

  

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third\-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

  

AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case\-by\-case basis.

===============


Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no\-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.


People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like\-minded people driving change at Howden.

**Who are we?**


Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no\-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.


People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like\-minded people driving change at Howden.

  

We’re looking for a junior to mid\-level C\#/.NET Developer (1–3 years’ experience) to join our Development Team and support the delivery of scalable, high\-quality software within a collaborative environment. As a member of our dynamic and supportive team, you will be tasked with delivering high\-performance, innovative, and dependable solutions to meet a diverse set of requirements.

**About role:**

* Develop high‑performance back‑end features using the Microsoft technology stack and contribute to technical design discussions within the engineering team.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts and fellow engineers to translate business requirements into **robust, scalable, and secure solutions**.
* Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve defects and production issues in a timely manner.
* Ensure code quality through **code reviews, automated testing**, and adherence to engineering standards and best practices.
* Support the wider team by sharing knowledge, providing constructive feedback, and contributing to the continuous improvement of engineering practices
* Can work effectively as part of a larger team, collaborating and communicating effectively, and building relationships with colleagues across the business

**About you:**

* Experience developing object‑oriented software using C\# and .NET (.NET 8 or later), with an awareness of the wider technology ecosystem.
* A solid understanding of object‑oriented principles and common design patterns, including SOLID.
* Experience building or contributing to .NET Web APIs and an understanding of microservices‑based architectures.
* Experience using Azure DevOps or GitHub for source control, work tracking, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with Agile development practices, with active participation in ceremonies such as stand‑ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
* Exposure to cloud technologies, preferably Microsoft Azure.
* Experience with or awareness of cloud‑based services such as Service Bus (or similar messaging systems), document databases (e.g. Cosmos DB or MongoDB) is preferred.
* Awareness of containerised applications and application monitoring tools such as Application Insights in the cloud, with some hands‑on exposure is beneficial.
* An enthusiastic and proactive developer with a desire to learn and deliver robust, high‑quality software.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to contribute to a high\-impact transformation programme in the insurance sector.
* Collaborative and forward\-thinking team environment.
* Flexible working arrangements.
* Access to modern engineering tools and practices.

**Rewards:**


We believe that great work and dedication should be rewarded, that’s why we offer:

* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), pro\-rated for part year service
* A set of core benefits, designed with your health and financial protection in mind:
* Life Assurance up to 4x salary, protecting your loved ones in case the worst should happen
* Income protection, guaranteeing an income for up to 5 years in the event of an illness or injury
* Contributory pension scheme – 5% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution
* Access to a Healthcare Cashplan, which gives you access to a variety of health\-related benefits
* Access to a host of lifestyle and financial benefits that you can choose from:
* Discounts on gym membership across the UK
* Salary sacrifice schemes – Travel Insurance, Cycle to Work, Car leasing, Technology purchase
* Access to discounted personal health policies – Critical illness, private medical, dental plans
* A range of insurance products available commission free, including home, motor, travel and specialist vehicles
* Access to hundreds of high\-street retailer discounts

**What do we offer in return?**
===============================


A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

* Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
* We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
* We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

**Reasonable adjustments**
==========================


We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours\* or hybrid working\*.


If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.

* Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.


Permanent

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

**Build. Scale. Sustain.**


We are a global technology consultancy with a trademarked, AI\-first engineering approach for accelerating the delivery of digital products, and revolutionizing platform modernization. **We do the right thing, and we do it right.** We're proud to be a World Economic Forum New Champion, and a B Corp\-certified company.

* We are **small enough to care locally, big enough to deliver globally**: 5 continents, 10 countries, \+500 experts from \+50 nationalities across the Americas, Europe and APAC
* We are **robust and resilient**: 100% independent and 0 debt
* We are **entrepreneurs and passionate experts**: We invest in what we believe genuinely and work as a collective intelligence
* We are **positive, courageous, caring, doers and committed to excellence**

 **About Gen\-e2**  

While the market is still largely AI\-augmenting delivery, we have reinvented the SDLC to be AI First. Leveraging our 16 years expertise in digital transformation, our approach is a game\-changer in productivity and quality, with a strong collaboration between IA generative and our best Talents:

* We now generate 95% of the entire product — code, documentation, infrastructure as code, and even design powered by GitHub Copilot.
* The quality consistently exceeds the output of our best traditional engineering teams.
* A product repository houses all product artefacts, giving AI full project context for higher\-quality generation.
* A library of rules and prompts defines coding standards, design principles, and security guidelines, ensuring enterprise\-grade quality and scalability.


With Gen\-e2, we deliver end\-to\-end products 2–3× faster than traditional approaches, while raising the bar for engineering excellence.

**Position Summary / Project Description**


The Power Platform Developer will be part of a small augmented delivery team standing up automation solutions for urgent, compliance\-driven use cases. This is a highly hands\-on, delivery\-focused role centred on building, testing, and deploying workflow and document\-automation solutions on the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, and Copilot Studio) together with SharePoint.


The initial focus is the HIPD Star Rated Items workflow — a multi\-stage process spanning vendor submission (FormSG with SingPass authentication), data ingestion into SharePoint, staff review and two\-level approval via Power Apps and Power Automate, and a reporting layer for querying and exporting item status. The developer will also support related urgent automation initiatives, including tender evaluation and documentcentric approval workflows.


The developer will work closely with the Lead BA / Solution Architect, HIPD process owners, and other business stakeholders to translate process requirements into robust, auditable, and maintainable solutions, and to produce the documentation and knowledge transfer needed for a clean handover at the end of the engagement.

 **Role and Responsibilities**

* Design, build, test, and deploy automation solutions using Power Apps (canvas and model\-driven), Power Automate, and SharePoint.
* Develop Power Apps forms and interfaces that surface item details for staff review, comment capture, and approval decisions.
* Build Power Automate flows to orchestrate multi\-stage workflows, including data ingestion, routing between reviewers, status updates, notifications, and clarification loops with vendors.
* Configure and manage SharePoint document libraries and lists as the system of record, including metadata, versioning, and status tracking (e.g., Pending Review, Approved, Rejected).
* Integrate submission channels such as FormSG (with SingPass / CorpPass authentication) into downstream SharePoint and Power Automate processing.
* Develop reporting interfaces that query SharePoint data and allow filtering by status, date, vendor, and project, with export capability for downstream use.
* Implement data\-seeding and reconciliation routines to import existing spreadsheet records and identify gaps before go\-live, including the use of Copilot to surface items from source systems such as Outlook where applicable.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**


Forward Deployed Engineers take a defined use case from nothing to a working, production\-grade system inside the customer's environment. That starts with knowing our platform deeply enough to combine its capabilities into solutions more complex than any single feature was designed for \- and where a customer's specific needs call for something beyond the standard functionality, building that missing piece themselves. This is the role that builds the use case: not a prototype handed to someone else to production, but the system that goes live.


This is a customer\-facing role. Understanding the customer's needs and the realistic possibilities of their technical environment \- and working in close, daily collaboration with them \- is what makes a deployment succeed. We're in daily working contact with the customer's engineers and executives, mostly online, with our team and theirs operating as one delivery unit with shared planning. Success is measured on the customer's numbers \- resolution rate, containment, response latency, CSAT, cost per contact \- and accountability continues past go\-live.


Forward Deployed Engineering brings together two disciplines that used to sit apart: conversation design and integration engineering. An engineer who can build the technical logic behind a scenario; a conversation designer who can design the flow of the conversation itself \- that is what an FDE is. We hire people who are genuinely strong in one of the two and want to grow the other \- expert in both is a direction of travel, not an entry bar. The role is based in Prague and is part of a global function with teams in EMEA and North America.


Please note this is a hybrid role with significant customer on\-site availability required.


**Responsibilities**

* Own the solution design: translate a stated business problem into a technical architecture that fits the customer’s actual processes, constraints and systems.
* Build the agent 01: design, build and iterate the first working version end to end \- the system that goes into production, not a hand\-off.
* Close product gaps: build the custom extensions, integrations, services and tooling the deployment requires, without waiting for core roadmap prioritization.
* Own the integration surface: systems of record, contact channels and data flows \- and, for voice deployments, the telephony path from carrier to agent.
* Evaluate, iterate, improve: define the workflow\-specific tests that determine whether this deployment actually works, and iterate against real traffic until the numbers move.
* Work as the customer’s technical counterpart: deploy alongside their engineers, monitor against the agreed KPIs, tune, and stay accountable past go\-live.
* Feed the platform: capture what you built as a reusable pattern and push recurring patterns toward the core product \- the field is our sensing arm.

  

**Requirements**  

* 2\+ years building and shipping software in a customer\-facing role \- solutions or forward\-deployed engineering, professional services delivery, integration engineering, or product engineering with direct customer exposure.
* Genuine depth in at least one of our two disciplines, and the appetite to grow the other: conversation and agent design (dialogue logic, prompting, flows, evaluation) or integration engineering (APIs, services, systems of record, data flows).
* Strong hands\-on coding in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and/or C\#/.NET \- comfortable writing and maintaining production services, not only scripts.
* Solid working experience of SQL, Linux and Docker \- just as important as the languages above.
* Solid grasp of software architecture and API integration: authentication, webhooks, queues, error handling and failure modes.
* Experience distributing data across critically loaded infrastructure, and the ability to account for race conditions, deadlocks and thread safety when designing systems.
* Ability to work directly with customer engineers and executives \- distil a complex system into a clear explanation, present a design, and defend a trade\-off.
* A track record of owning a complex project end to end, against real deliverables and real dates.
* Comfort with ambiguity and with non\-deterministic systems: forming a hypothesis, building the evaluation that tests it, and iterating to a number.
* Willingness to travel.
* Professional English, used daily with colleagues in EMEA and North America; Czech strongly preferred for work with regional customers.

**Preferred Experience**

* Conversational AI or voice agents in production \- flow and prompt design, retrieval, tool calling, and evaluation harnesses against real traffic.
* Contact centre and CCaaS platforms (Genesys, Avaya, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect) plus telephony fundamentals \- SIP, DTMF, transfer, failover.
* Integration with enterprise systems of record: CRM, ERP, data warehouses, custom internal APIs.
* Cloud and container deployment (Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).
* GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and data residency handled as architectural constraints, not paperwork.
* Using AI tooling as a core part of how you build, not a side tab you open occasionally.
* Additional Central European languages, particularly Slovak, Polish or German.

  

**Benefits**  

  

**About CallMiner**
Does the possibility of using artificial intelligence to improve human connection excite you? We agree!


CallMiner is the global leader in AI\-powered conversation intelligence and customer experience (CX) automation. Our industry\-recognized platform captures and analyzes 100% of omnichannel customer interactions delivering the insights organizations need to improve CX, enhance agent performance, and drive automation at scale. By combining advanced AI, industry\-leading analytics, and real\-time conversation intelligence, we empower organizations to uncover customer needs, optimize processes, and automate workflows and interactions. The result: higher customer satisfaction, reduced operational costs, and faster, data\-driven decisions. Trusted by leading brands in technology, media \& telecom, retail, manufacturing, financial services, healthcare, and travel \& hospitality, we help organizations transform customer insights into action.


CallMiner's core set of values – from maniacal customer focus and radical candor to team mentality and transparency – serve as a touchstone for what we strive to create in a workplace culture and weave through everything we do as a company. We believe that by building a team of brilliant, inspired people, we can truly accomplish amazing things together. We are committed to providing an inclusive and equitable workplace where everyone feels accepted, valued, and understood.


Our strong commitment to a positive environment continually earns us recognition as a top workplace, including Boston Globe Top Place to Work.

 **Benefits \+ Perks**
At CallMiner, we believe having a work\-life balance is key to being able to deliver your best every day. Our perks are designed to enhance your daily work experience, promote your personal growth, and help you achieve a better work\-life balance. From Maternity and Paternity Leave, ample Holidays, Fitness and Health Reimbursement, Tuition Reimbursement and more, we aim to provide an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally.

Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.

You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.

jobs.title: RPA Developer (gn) - Location Bucharest
jobs.description:
Your job at DKV Mobility? As part of a leading European B2B platform for on\-the\-road payment solutions, you will work in an exciting environment. Our tasks are defined by our Purpose: To drive the transition towards an efficient and sustainable future of mobility. We offer you numerous opportunities to help shape the mobility of tomorrow in a dynamic and agile environment. Our approximately 2,700 employees throughout Europe are united by a common passion: to give their best every day for our customers in more than 50 countries. True to our claim: You drive, we care. Become part of our diverse, dedicated and unique team!


What you can expect
In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy RPA solutions to automate business processes. The ideal candidate will have experience with RPA tools like UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism and will possess a strong understanding of business process analysis, solution design, and automation best practices.


* Collaborate with business analysts, process owners, and stakeholders to identify automation opportunities
* Document automation processes and solutions, ensuring they are easily maintainable and scalable
* Troubleshoot and resolve RPA issues, providing ongoing support and maintenance
* Develop and conduct RPA testing to ensure the accuracy and reliability of automated solutions
* Monitor RPA performance, recommend improvements, and ensure high availability
* Continuously stay up to date with the latest trends and best practices in RPA technology
* Ensure RPA solutions comply with governance and security standards
* Provide training and guidance to other team members on RPA best practices
  

  

What makes you stand out
* Proven experience in RPA development (minimum 3 years) using tools like UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism
* Strong programming skills in languages such as C\#, .NET, Java, or Python
* Knowledge of software development methodologies, Agile frameworks, and version control
* Experience with process mapping and business process analysis
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

What we offer:


* Attractive benefits package
* Regina Maria medical subscription for you and your family according to internal policy
* Meal vouchers
* Private pension plan
* Special discounts for gyms
* Additional days off
* DKV card with discount for fuel valid in 25 countries
* When you are in the office can have free facilities like massage, fruits, coffee
* Flexible working hours with home office and flextime
* Continuous training and much more...

\#LI\-DNP

  

We are looking forward to your application and to applicants who enrich our diverse culture! Regardless of age, gender, origin and sexual identity and orientation. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if equally qualified. This position can be full\-time or part\-time (min. 30h/week). DKV Mobility is looking for the best talents and knows that these are not always available on a full\-time basis. Many of our employees work part\-time or in flexible working models. Please talk to us about the flexibility you need during the application process.


**Why DKV Mobility? Here are five good reasons...**
---------------------------------------------------


At DKV Mobility, we are team players \- because we are only successful together! **\#teamofteams**
  

You should feel welcome with us from the very beginning!


### **We've been growing for about 90 years**


How we do it? We keep adapting our products and business model to meet changing customer needs. That's how we stay mobile and master every challenge the future holds.


There are also many other good reasons to work at DKV Mobility. For example, we offer you comprehensive company health management, parent\-child offices (from 2023\) and support you in leasing your eBike through our partner Jobrad!


### **We attach great importance to work\-life balance.**


We stand for the compatibility of family and career! That's why we offer flexible working hours and family\-friendly working time models. In addition, we rely on a balanced mix of on\-site meetings and home office.


### **We support you in your development**


We offer you optimal conditions to familiarize yourself so that you can quickly find your way around and become a part of the team! To further your personal development, we offer you access to a modern learning environment \- independent of time and location. This way you can also face the challenges of tomorrow!


### **We are committed to a net\-zero future**


After reaching our Green Pledge climate target in 2023 by reducing carbon emissions in our own business operations by 50\.4% compared to the base year 2019, we set ourselves ambitious net\-zero climate targets. The targets have been validated by the Science Based Targets initiative. By 2050, DKV Mobility commits to reach net\-zero greenhouse gas emissions across the value chain from a 2022 base year. You want to take climate action? Follow us on our road to net\-zero.


### **We are a certified employer**


Our employees trust us. As an employer, we regularly receive awards from independent institutes, e.g. as Top Employer Germany and as Great Place to Work!


Did you know that we have received several awards as an employer in recent years?

  

Have we made you curious? Then we are looking forward to your application! If you still have open questions then please contact **Luminita Neagu** via luminita.neagu@dkv\-mobility.com.

jobs.description:
**About Us**  

At SILVARE, we're a dynamic team achieving remarkable results. We've built a reputation for delivering fast, impactful results that keep our clients coming back, many of whom are some of the biggest names in tech.  

  

**What Μakes Us Different**  

We're easy to talk to, we get straight to the point and we're all about making things happen. We're proud of the strong relationships we build, both with our team and our clients. We believe in keeping our people happy, whether it's through improving benefits, having open conversations about their projects or just being there when they need us. It's a supportive environment and culture that helps both us and our people thrive. If you're ready to work on exciting projects, grow alongside industry leaders and make a real impact, we'd love to have you join us at SILVARE.

 **Role Overview**


MDM Data Integration Engineer brings the data into Profisee and delivers the golden record to the systems and users that need it. Owns the technical integration architecture and platform operation: source extraction, ingestion pipelines, initial load, outbound publication, write\-back to source systems, environments, security, and monitoring.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Analyse source systems (SAP/ERP, CIS/Billing, meter data management, GIS/network, CRM, HR, legacy) and design the integration architecture: batch vs real\-time, one\-way vs bidirectional flows
* Build ingestion pipelines with Azure Data Factory or Microsoft Fabric and execute the initial load with reconciliation per source
* Build outbound flows delivering the golden record to the data warehouse/lakehouse, Power BI, and other consumers
* Implement write\-back to source systems via REST APIs, webhooks, or Profisee Connect, with error handling and retry logic
* Administer SQL Server, dev/test/prod environments, configuration deployments, and integration with Microsoft Entra ID
* Set up monitoring, alerting, and logging for pipelines and platform
* Support the Functional Consultant with data profiling and large\-volume matching tests; document the technical architecture and runbooks

 **What You'll Bring**

* 3\+ years of data engineering on Azure
* Strong SQL Server / T\-SQL
* Azure Data Factory or Microsoft Fabric
* REST APIs, JSON, and authentication flows
* Python or C\#
* Git and CI/CD practices

 **Nice to Haves**

* Profisee or another MDM platform
* SAP integration (OData, IDoc, BAPI)
* Kubernetes and Azure networking
* Microsoft Entra ID and RBAC
* Power BI semantic models
* Experience with energy\-sector systems (CIS, MDMS, GIS) and their data volumes

 **How We Support Your Growth**

* Lunch Is On Us: Monthly allowance for your favorite meals.
* Health First: Private health \& life insurance for peace of mind.
* Set Up For Success: The right tools to stay connected and perform your best.
* Curiosity Never Retires: Access to Udemy for unlimited learning.

* Work With The Best: Collaborate with industry\-leading clients.
* Celebrate Diversity: Be part of a team that values every perspective.
* Performance Pays Off: Annual discretionary bonus based on yearly contributions.
* Social Responsibility: Give back through volunteering and sustainability.

 **Excited to Make an Impact?** Apply today and be part of what we're building together  

  

*At* SILVARE*, we are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of our workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.*  

  

*Last but not least, we remain fully committed to protecting your privacy. Our operations align strictly with the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679\. Any personal data provided within this application is processed and stored in full accordance with applicable data protection laws, utilized solely to evaluate your candidacy for recruitment purposes.*

jobs.title: Sportsbook Software Architect
jobs.description:
**About Kairostek**
===================


At Kairostek, we believe great technology starts with great people.


We foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth, empowering our team to make a meaningful impact while building solutions that shape the future. Our teams work across software engineering, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, digital products, payments technology, and technology operations to deliver scalable and innovative solutions for global organizations.


If you are passionate about technology, problem\-solving, and continuous learning, we would love to hear from you.

**About the Role**
==================


We are looking for an experienced Sportsbook Software Architect with strong expertise in sports betting and iGaming platforms to design and evolve scalable, high\-performance sportsbook systems. The ideal candidate combines deep sportsbook domain knowledge with strong experience in distributed systems, microservices, real\-time processing, and cloud architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Design and evolve end\-to\-end architecture for sportsbook platforms, including odds feeds, trading, bet placement, settlement, risk, and player management.

* Architect high\-volume, low\-latency systems supporting both pre\-match and live betting.
* Design integrations with odds providers, trading platforms, content providers, payments, CRM, KYC, and risk systems.
* Define scalable microservices, REST/gRPC APIs, event\-driven architectures, and real\-time data flows.
* Ensure reliability, security, observability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery across critical sportsbook services.
* Work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, Risk, Compliance, and Operations teams.
* Support regulatory and compliance requirements including UKGC, MGA, responsible gambling, audit, and anti\-fraud controls.
* Guide engineering teams and promote architecture, coding, testing, and DevOps best practices.
**Qualifications \& Experience**
================================

* 3\+ years of experience as a Software/Solution Architect with strong Sportsbook/iGaming experience.
* Strong understanding of sportsbook domain and betting lifecycle, including:


	+ Pre\-match \& live betting
	+ Odds feeds and pricing
	+ Markets and events
	+ Betslip \& bet processing
	+ Trading and odds management
	+ Settlement
	+ Player profiling, risk \& stake controls

* Strong experience with microservices, distributed systems, REST/gRPC, and event\-driven architecture.
* Experience with technologies such as Java, C\#/.NET, Node.js, Go, or similar.
* Experience with Kafka/RabbitMQ, SQL/NoSQL databases, and Redis or other caching technologies.
* Strong experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience with high\-performance, real\-time systems and live data/streaming architectures.
* Excellent communication, technical leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
**Nice to Have**

* Experience with sportsbook platform migration or modernization.
* Knowledge of UKGC/MGA regulatory requirements.
* Experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP architecture, and TOGAF.
**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive compensation package.
* Flexible and remote\-friendly work environment.
* Professional growth and development opportunities.
* Exposure to international projects and teams.
* Collaborative and inclusive company culture.
* Opportunity to work with modern technologies and innovative solutions.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
==============================


Kairostek is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or background.

jobs.title: Backend Developer .NET
jobs.description:
### **Onderneming**

### **Functie**


Om de verdere groei van het bedrijf te ondersteunen zijn we op zoek naar een **Backend Developer .NET**. In deze functie werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling, modernisering en verdere uitbouw van onze interne softwareoplossingen en het achterliggende servicelandschap.


Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:


* Het zelfstandig meewerken aan verschillende softwareprojecten, in nauwe samenwerking met andere developers, functionele analisten en de application architect.
* Het vertalen van functionele en business requirements naar technische oplossingen, en het actief meedenken over een passende en pragmatische technische aanpak.
* Het ontwikkelen, testen en onderhouden van backendservices en REST API's binnen een microservicearchitectuur.
* Het ontwikkelen van nieuwe toepassingen en services, maar ook het moderniseren en verder uitbouwen van bestaande oplossingen.
* Het werken met zowel synchrone als asynchrone communicatie tussen services, onder andere via REST API's en messaging.
* Het schrijven van onderhoudbare, testbare en consistente code volgens de afgesproken development\- en architectuurconventies.
* Het actief deelnemen aan code reviews en mee bewaken van de kwaliteit van de codebase.
* Het helpen verbeteren van onze development lifecycle, technische standaarden en development guidelines.
* Het actief opvolgen van relevante evoluties binnen het .NET\-ecosysteem en samen met het team beoordelen waar nieuwe technologie een meerwaarde kan bieden.

### **Profiel**


In deze functie verwachten we dat je zelfstandig kan werken, initiatief neemt en actief meedenkt over technische keuzes. Je werkt binnen een team van developers en analisten en kan technische beslissingen duidelijk onderbouwen en bespreken.


* Opleiding en ervaring – Je hebt een bachelor\- of masterdiploma Informatica of bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring. Je hebt minstens 3 jaar relevante ervaring als backend developer en een sterke interesse in softwareontwikkeling en softwarekwaliteit.
* **Analyse** – Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch vermogen. Je kan complexe problemen structureren, pragmatische oplossingen uitwerken en technische keuzes onderbouwen.
* **Zelfstandigheid en samenwerking** – Je kan zelfstandig taken opnemen en prioriteiten bewaken, maar werkt tegelijk graag samen met andere developers, analisten en architecten. Je communiceert duidelijk over technische keuzes, problemen en mogelijke oplossingen.
* **Can do** – Je bent leergierig, communiceert vlot en kan zelfstandig prioriteiten stellen.
* **Kwaliteitsgericht werken** – Je hecht belang aan leesbare en onderhoudbare code, geautomatiseerde tests, consistente ontwikkelstandaarden en degelijke code reviews.
* **Talenkennis** – Je beheerst vlot de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Kennis van Frans is een pluspunt.

**Technische kennis**
---------------------


Je hebt hands\-on ervaring met:


* **C\# en modern .NET**, bij voorkeur .NET 8 of recenter
* Het ontwikkelen van **REST API's** met ASP.NET Core
* **Entity Framework Core** en relationele databases, bij voorkeur SQL Server
* Asynchroon programmeren
* Dependency injection en gangbare .NET\-ontwikkelpatronen
* Git en een professionele development workflow met branches, pull requests en code reviews.


Ervaring met één of meerdere van onderstaande technologieën of concepten is een sterke meerwaarde:


* Microservice architectuur
* **CQRS** en event\-driven architectuur
* Asynchronous messaging, bijvoorbeeld met **MassTransit en RabbitMQ**
* **NoSQL** databases
* **Minimal APIs** en API\-versioning
* EF Core
* JWT\-gebaseerde authenticatie en autorisatie
* Automated testing met bijvoorbeeld **xUnit** en **Moq**
* CI/CD en work management via **Azure DevOps**
* Domeinmodellering en principes uit **Domain\-Driven Design** en **SOLID**, toegepast op een pragmatische manier
* Logging, monitoring en observability, bijvoorbeeld via Application Insights

### **Aanbod**


Wat bieden wij?

* Functie – Je maakt deel uit van het IT team en rapporteert aan Head of IT Architechture \& BI.
* Salaris – we bieden een competitief salarispakket bestaande uit een vast loon, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, hospitalisatieverzekering, groepsverzekering, firmawagen en 30% personeelskorting bij ZEB, The Fashion Store en PointCarré.
* Thuiswerkdag \- wekelijks een dag thuiswerk
* Een mooie werkplek en een toffe werksfeer, in een ambitieus en creatief team

	+ Analyseren van topografische, geospatiale en geotechnische gegevens voor het creëren van realistische en betrouwbare modellen.
	+ Uitvoeren van dimensionering en berekeningen voor wegontwerpen, waterbeheer en andere infrastructuurnetwerken.
* Samenwerking met projectteams:
	+ Nauw samenwerken met interne teams en externe stakeholders om ervoor te zorgen dat ontwerpen voldoen aan specificaties en lokale normen.
	+ Coördineren met de ontwerp\-, engineering\- en constructieteams om de technische haalbaarheid van projecten te waarborgen.
* Analyseren van projectgegevens en simulaties uitvoeren:
	+ Integreren van geografische gegevens en andere informatie uit terreinmetingen in BIM\-modellen voor een efficiënter ontwerp\- en bouwproces.
	+ Gebruik maken van simulaties om de impact van het ontwerp te evalueren op milieu, kosten en tijd.
* Ondersteuning bij documentatie en rapporten:
	+ Ondersteunen bij het opstellen van projectdocumentatie, rapporten en presentaties voor klanten en belanghebbenden.

  





**We horen graag van mensen met**

  


* Minimaal een bachelor in Civiele Techniek, Bouwkunde of een gerelateerd vakgebied.
* Uitgebreide ervaring met **Autodesk InfraWorks** en **Civil 3D.**
	+ Autodesk InfraWorks: Gedetailleerd 3D\-modelleren van infrastructuurprojecten en het uitvoeren van simulaties van realistische scenario’s.
	+ Autodesk Civil 3D: Ontwerpen van wegen, analyse van rioleringssystemen en het beheren van topografische en geotechnische data.
	+ BIM (Building Information Modeling): Bekwaamheid in het werken met BIM voor het optimaliseren van ontwerpprocessen en de samenwerking tussen verschillende teams.
* Grondige kennis van infrastructuurontwerp en \-modellering.
	+ Grondige kennis van **ontwerpprincipes voor hoofdwegen, primaire wegen en andere infrastructuurelementen.**
	+ Ervaring in het ontwerpen en modelleren van rioleringssystemen, wegen en andere civiele infrastructuur.
* Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met het werken in teamverband.
* Probleemoplossend vermogen en oog voor detail.

  



**Ons rekruteringsproces**


* Pre\-screeningsgesprek / diepgaand HR\-interview (op locatie of via Teams) met de Talent Acquisition Partner
* 1 of 2 inhoudelijke interviews (bij voorkeur op locatie) met uw toekomstige manager

  



Onderzoek toont aan dat mannen solliciteren wanneer ze aan 60% van de vereisten voldoen, terwijl vrouwen pas solliciteren wanneer ze ervan overtuigd zijn dat ze aan 100% voldoen. Laat je daardoor niet tegenhouden – we horen graag van je!

  


**Wie je bent**

* **Communicatievaardigheden**: Het vermogen om effectief en duidelijk te communiceren in het Nederlands met projectteams, klanten en andere belanghebbenden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
* **Samenwerken in teamverband**: Ervaring met het werken in een multidisciplinair team en het succesvol bereiken van gezamenlijke ontwerpdoelen.
* **Probleemoplossend vermogen**: Sterk analytisch denkvermogen en het vermogen om technische problemen snel te identificeren en op te lossen.
* **Oog voor detail:** Zorgvuldigheid en precisie in ontwerpwerkzaamheden, waarbij geen enkel detail over het hoofd wordt gezien.
* **Tijdbeheer en organisatie:** Het vermogen om meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd te beheren en prioriteiten te stellen om deadlines te halen

  


**Wie we zijn**

Klaar om je positieve impact vorm te geven? Sluit je dan aan bij Tractebel, onderdeel van de **ENGIE Groep**, en onze 5600 gepassioneerde **experts** wereldwijd die zich iedere dag inzetten om te bouwen aan een **duurzamere wereld**.
